title.zh: 卷524 列傳三百十一 藩部七 唐努乌梁海 阿尔泰乌梁海 阿尔泰淖尔乌梁海
title.en: Volume 524 Biographies 311: Frontier Dependencies 7: Tannu Uriankhai, Altai Uriankhai, Altai Nuur Uriankhai
title.raw: 卷524 列傳三百十一 藩部七 唐努乌梁海 阿尔泰乌梁海 阿尔泰淖尔乌梁海

sentences.zh: 唐努烏梁海，在烏裏雅蘇台之北，東南土謝圖汗部，南賽音諾顏部，西阿勒泰烏梁海，西南扎薩克圖汗部，北俄羅斯。

translations.literal: Tannu Uriankhai lies north of Uliassutai, southeast of the Tsetsen Khan Banner, south of the Sayn Noyan Banner, west of the Altai Uriankhai, southwest of the Zasaghtu Khan Banner, and north of Russia.
translations.idiomatic: The Tannu Uriankhai lay north of Uliassutai, with the Tsetsen Khan Banner to the southeast, the Sayn Noyan Banner to the south, the Altai Uriankhai to the west, the Zasaghtu Khan Banner to the southwest, and Russia to the north.

sentences.zh: 有總管五：曰唐努，曰薩拉吉克，曰托錦，曰庫布蘇庫勒諾爾，曰奇木奇克河。

translations.literal: There are five superintendents: namely Tannu, Sarajik, Tojin, Kubsugul Nor, and Kimchik River.
translations.idiomatic: The region was divided among five superintendents: Tannu, Sarajik, Tojin, Kubsugul Nor, and Kimchik River.

sentences.zh: 康熙五十四年，扎薩克圖汗部和托輝特輔國公博貝隨大軍赴推河防準噶爾策妄阿拉布坦，言：「準噶爾不靖，恃烏梁海障之。

translations.literal: In the fifty-fourth year of Kangxi, the Zasaghtu Khan Banner and Khotoi Khotogo Tribe Assistant Prince Bobai accompanied the grand army to the Tui River to guard against the Dzungar Cebdan Araltan, saying: "The Dzungars are unsettled and rely on the Uriankhai as a barrier."
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 54, Assistant Prince Bobai of the Zasaghtu Khan Banner and the Khotoi Khotogo Tribe marched with the main force to the Tui River to check the Dzungar leader Cebdan Araltan. He reported that the Dzungars were still restless and were shielded by the Uriankhai.

sentences.zh: 乞往招，若抗即以兵取。

translations.literal: I beg to go summon them; if they resist, take them immediately by force.
translations.idiomatic: He asked permission to go and win them over, and to seize them by force if they refused.

sentences.zh: 扎薩克台吉濟納彌達阿裏雅及根敦羅卜藏克兵俱習戰，請與同往。

translations.literal: The Zasaghtu taiji Jina Midariya and Gendun Lobzang's troops are all skilled in warfare; I request they go together.
translations.idiomatic: The Zasaghtu taiji Jina Midariya and the soldiers under Gendun Lobzang were all seasoned fighters, and he asked that they accompany the mission.

sentences.zh: 」上韙其議，從之。

translations.literal: The emperor approved his proposal and assented.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved the plan and granted his request.

sentences.zh: 九月，烏梁海頭目和羅爾邁率屬降。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, the Uriankhai chief Khorolmai led his followers in submission.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the Uriankhai chief Khorolmai submitted with his people.

sentences.zh: 先是和羅爾邁居吹河，嘗以越界射獵為博貝縛獻，上宥其罪，諭還巢。

translations.literal: Previously Khorolmai had dwelt on the Chui River and was once bound and presented by Bobai for hunting beyond the border; the emperor pardoned his crime and ordered him to return to his nest.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Khorolmai had lived on the Chui River. Bobai had once seized him for hunting across the border and sent him up as a captive, but the throne pardoned him and told him to return to his own grounds.

sentences.zh: 至是將遣子瑚洛處納請降。

translations.literal: At this time he was about to send his son Kholochun to request surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Now he was preparing to send his son Kholochun to offer submission.

sentences.zh: 博貝至，因遷其遊牧赴特斯。

translations.literal: When Bobai arrived, he therefore moved their pastoral encampments to Tes.
translations.idiomatic: When Bobai arrived, he relocated their herds to Tes.

sentences.zh: 冬，和羅爾邁遁，博貝追至呼爾罕什巴爾，執之。

translations.literal: In winter Khorolmai fled; Bobai pursued him to Khurkhan Shibar and arrested him.
translations.idiomatic: That winter Khorolmai fled again. Bobai overtook him at Khurkhan Shibar and took him prisoner.

sentences.zh: 五十九年，博貝擒烏梁海逃眾，晉貝勒。

translations.literal: In the fifty-ninth year Bobai captured fleeing Uriankhai and was promoted to beile.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-ninth year Bobai rounded up fugitive Uriankhai and was raised to the rank of beile.

sentences.zh: 時從征西將軍祁裏德軍。

translations.literal: At the time he was with the army of the western campaign general Qilide.
translations.idiomatic: He was then serving in the army of the western expedition commander Qilide.

sentences.zh: 六十年六月，議政王大臣議覆祁裏德，新收烏梁海二千五百三十名，應送至巴顏諾爾克地方居住，令車臣汗等旗分派兵三百名，並派台吉協同駐紮防守。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the sixtieth year the Council of Princes and Ministers considered Qilide's memorial: the newly received 2,530 Uriankhai should be sent to dwell at Bayannuur, with three hundred troops from the Chengen Khan and other banners assigned and taiji dispatched together to garrison and defend.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the sixtieth year the Council of Princes and Ministers replied to Qilide's memorial: the 2,530 Uriankhai just brought in should be settled at Bayannuur, with three hundred men drawn from the Chengen Khan Banner and other banners, and taiji officers sent to garrison the area jointly.

sentences.zh: 雍正二年，諭曰：「朕詢貝勒博貝，管轄烏梁海何以資生。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yongzheng an edict said: "I inquired of Beile Bobai how the Uriankhai under his jurisdiction make their living."
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 2 the throne asked how the Uriankhai under Beile Bobai's jurisdiction supported themselves.

sentences.zh: 據奏在將軍祁裏德處借餉一萬八千餘兩，買牲分給，各得產業，今勝於昔。

translations.literal: According to his memorial they had borrowed over 18,000 taels of provisions from General Qilide, bought livestock and distributed them, each obtaining property, and now are better off than before.
translations.idiomatic: His memorial reported that he had borrowed more than eighteen thousand taels of provisions from General Qilide, bought livestock, and distributed herds so that each household had a livelihood; they were now better off than before.

sentences.zh: 所有借項，自以貝勒俸逐年扣抵。

translations.literal: All borrowed sums would be deducted year by year from the beile's stipend.
translations.idiomatic: The debt was to be repaid gradually from his beile stipend.

sentences.zh: 朕思烏梁海俱朕之百姓，豈有朕之百姓而借餉於朕之理？

translations.literal: I consider that all Uriankhai are my subjects—how can my subjects borrow provisions from me?
translations.idiomatic: The emperor reflected that every Uriankhai was his subject; how could subjects be borrowing provisions from their own sovereign?

sentences.zh: 所借銀兩，不必扣還。

translations.literal: The borrowed silver need not be repaid.
translations.idiomatic: The borrowed silver was not to be repaid.

sentences.zh: 諭祁裏德知之。

translations.literal: Inform Qilide of this order.
translations.idiomatic: Qilide was instructed accordingly.

sentences.zh: 」三年，烏梁海和羅爾邁復遁，由阿哩克竄準噶爾界，博貝遣子額璘沁由托濟邀擒，而自赴克木克木齊克緝叛黨，誅之。

translations.literal: In the third year the Uriankhai Khorolmai fled again, slipping through Ari into Dzungar territory; Bobai sent his son Erlingjin to intercept and capture him at Toji, while he himself went to Kemkemchik to apprehend rebellious parties and executed them.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year Khorolmai fled once more and slipped through Ari into Dzungar territory. Bobai sent his son Erlingjin to cut him off at Toji and take him, while he himself went to Kemkemchik to round up rebel bands and put them to death.

sentences.zh: 初額魯特與喀爾喀構兵時，錯處科布多、烏蘭固木。

translations.literal: When the Oirats and Khalkha first fought, they were misplaced in Kobdo and Uran Ulaan.
translations.idiomatic: When the Oirats and Khalkha first went to war, the Uriankhai had been stationed in the wrong places around Kobdo and Uran Ulaan.

sentences.zh: 噶爾丹既滅，喀爾喀西境直抵阿勒泰，自唐努山陰之克木克木齊克至博木等處，皆博貝及來歸之額魯特貝淩旺布所屬烏梁海遊牧。

translations.literal: After Galdan was destroyed, the Khalkha western border extended straight to the Altai; from Kemkemchik on the northern slope of the Tannu Mountains to Bomu and other places, all were pastoral lands of Uriankhai subjects of Bobai and the returned Oirat beile Lingwangbu.
translations.idiomatic: After Galdan's defeat the Khalkha western frontier ran straight to the Altai. From Kemkemchik on the northern face of the Tannu range to Bomu and beyond, the pastures belonged to Uriankhai under Bobai and the returned Oirat beile Lingwangbu.

sentences.zh: 四年，策旺阿拉布坦言克木克木齊克舊隸準噶爾，乞還，上不許，慮伺間略烏梁海，詔博貝率所部兵千，隨前鋒統領定壽駐唐努山陽特斯地方防護之。

translations.literal: In the fourth year Cewang Araltan said Kemkemchik had formerly been subordinate to the Dzungars and begged for its return; the emperor did not permit this, fearing they might seize an opportunity to encroach on the Uriankhai; he ordered Bobai to lead a thousand troops of his division together with vanguard commander Ding Shou to garrison the Tes region on the southern slope of the Tannu Mountains for protection.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year Cewang Araltan claimed that Kemkemchik had once belonged to the Dzungars and asked for its return. The emperor refused, fearing a chance to prey on the Uriankhai. Bobai was ordered to lead a thousand of his men with the vanguard commander Ding Shou to garrison Tes on the southern slope of the Tannu Mountains.

sentences.zh: 尋諭理籓院曰：「朕詳思克木克木齊克烏梁海皆博貝所屬，和羅爾邁既已就擒，交博貝撫恤，居之公所。

translations.literal: Soon an edict to the Lifan Yuan said: "I have carefully considered that all the Kemkemchik Uriankhai belong to Bobai; Khorolmai having been captured, they should be entrusted to Bobai for soothing and management, residing at the public lodging."
translations.idiomatic: Soon the Lifan Yuan was told that all Kemkemchik Uriankhai belonged to Bobai. With Khorolmai in custody, they should be placed under Bobai's care at the official station.

sentences.zh: 但念此等人向在喀爾喀邊外林木中射獵為生，與準噶爾所屬烏梁海接壤，又與俄羅斯連界。

translations.literal: But considering that these people formerly made their living hunting in the forests beyond the Khalkha border, and border the Dzungar Uriankhai and also adjoin Russia.
translations.idiomatic: Yet these people had long lived by hunting in the woods beyond the Khalkha frontier, pressed against both Dzungar Uriankhai and the Russian border.

sentences.zh: 宜令博貝等同大臣前往曉諭，令自為預備，以防不虞。

translations.literal: Bobai and others should be ordered to go with ministers to instruct them, to make their own preparations against unforeseen events.
translations.idiomatic: Bobai and the ministers should go and warn them to prepare on their own against any surprise.

sentences.zh: 」三月，命大臣一員帶布帛茶葉賞克木克木齊克地方烏梁海，並令揀老成服眾之人作為首領。

translations.literal: In the third month one minister was ordered to bring cloth, tea, and other rewards for the Kemkemchik Uriankhai, and to select persons of mature judgment whom the masses obey to serve as leaders.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month a minister was sent with cloth, tea, and gifts for the Kemkemchik Uriankhai, and told to choose respected elders to head each group.

sentences.zh: 五年，額駙策淩等與俄羅斯訂約，自恰克圖、鄂爾輝圖兩間為界，所立之鄂博，迤西至肯哲馮達霍呢音嶺、克木克木齊克之博木、沙弼納嶺。

translations.literal: In the fifth year the imperial son-in-law Tsering and others concluded a treaty with Russia; from Kiakhta and Erkhii Tu as boundaries, the erected cairns extended west to the Kenje Fenda Khoniin ridge, Kemkemchik's Bomu, and Shabina ridge.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year the imperial son-in-law Tsering and others made a treaty with Russia. The boundary ran between Kiakhta and Erkhii Tu, with cairns set westward along the Kenje Fenda Khoniin ridge, Bomu at Kemkemchik, and Shabina ridge.

sentences.zh: 循此山梁，由正中分中劃界，其兩邊各取五貂之烏梁海，仍令照舊各歸其主，彼此各徵一貂之烏梁海。

translations.literal: Following this mountain ridge, the boundary was drawn through the center; on each side five sable-tributing Uriankhai were taken, still left to return to their original masters as before, each side levying one sable-tributing Uriankhai.
translations.idiomatic: Along the ridge a line was drawn down the middle. Each side took five sable-paying Uriankhai bands, who were still to remain under their former lords, while each side also levied one additional sable-paying band from the other.

sentences.zh: 自定界之日，將各取一貂之處停止。

translations.literal: From the day the boundary was fixed, the places where each side took one sable were stopped.
translations.idiomatic: From the day the border was fixed, the practice of each side taking one sable-tributing band was ended.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十六年，以和托輝特扎薩克貝勒青袞咱卜縱所屬人私出汛界與準噶爾回眾貿易，致潛居烏梁海，奪貝勒，詔額璘沁襲其爵，定烏梁海出入汛界例。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Qianlong, because the Khotoi Khotogo zasaghtu beile Chingunjab permitted his people to cross the patrol border privately to trade with Dzungar Muslims, enabling Uriankhai to dwell secretly, his beile rank was taken away; Erlingjin was ordered to succeed to his title; regulations on Uriankhai crossing patrol borders were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 16 the Khotoi Khotogo zasaghtu beile Chingunjab was stripped of his rank for letting his people slip past the patrol line to trade with Dzungar Muslims and harbor Uriankhai in secret. Erlingjin was ordered to succeed him, and rules governing Uriankhai movement across the patrol border were laid down.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，青袞咱卜脅烏梁海叛，大兵至，皆棄去。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year Chingunjab coerced the Uriankhai to rebel; when the grand army arrived, all abandoned him.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year Chingunjab forced the Uriankhai into rebellion, but when imperial troops arrived his followers deserted him.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，鑄唐努烏梁海總管印給之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year seals for Tannu Uriankhai superintendents were cast and granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year official seals were cast for the Tannu Uriankhai superintendents.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶二年，烏裏雅蘇台參贊大臣額樂春以需索烏梁海奪職治罪。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jiaqing the Uliassutai assistant minister Erlekun was dismissed and punished for extorting the Uriankhai.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 2 the Uliassutai assistant minister Erlekun was dismissed and punished for extorting the Uriankhai.

sentences.zh: 道光三年，定禁烏梁海與商民貿易例，以山西民人私向烏梁海買取羊只涉訟。

translations.literal: In the third year of Daoguang regulations forbidding Uriankhai trade with merchants were fixed, on account of Shanxi commoners privately buying sheep from the Uriankhai, causing lawsuits.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 3 trade between Uriankhai and private merchants was banned after Shanxi traders buying sheep on the sly led to lawsuits.

sentences.zh: 二十四年六月，烏裏雅蘇台將軍桂輪劾總管垂敦紮布需索無厭，奪職。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the twenty-fourth year the Uliassutai general Gui Lun memorialized that Superintendent Choidunjab was insatiable in extortion and stripped him of office.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the twenty-fourth year Uliassutai General Gui Lun impeached Superintendent Choidunjab for endless exactions and removed him from office.

sentences.zh: 咸豐年，奏唐努烏梁海界址。

translations.literal: In the Xianfeng years the boundaries of Tannu Uriankhai were submitted.
translations.idiomatic: During the Xianfeng reign the boundaries of Tannu Uriankhai were reported to the throne.

sentences.zh: 十年，與俄國定界約，是部之沙賓達巴哈實為西疆劃界之第一地段。

translations.literal: In the tenth year a boundary treaty was fixed with Russia; Shabindaba of this department was actually the first section delimiting the western frontier.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year a boundary treaty was made with Russia. Shabindaba in this region marked the first stretch of the western frontier to be demarcated.

sentences.zh: 同治三年十一月，烏裏雅蘇台將軍明誼等奏：「唐努烏梁海遊牧內，俄使前開議單，載唐努鄂拉達巴哈即系唐努山嶺，自沙賓達巴哈界牌起，先往西，後往南。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the third year of Tongzhi Uliassutai General Mingyi and others memorialized: "Within the pastoral lands of Tannu Uriankhai, the Russian envoy's earlier discussion list states that Tannu Uladabaha is the Tannu mountain ridge, from the Shabindaba boundary marker first west then south."
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of Tongzhi 3 Uliassutai General Mingyi and others reported that within Tannu Uriankhai pastures the Russian envoy's earlier negotiating paper identified Tannu Uladabaha as the Tannu ridge, running from the Shabindaba marker first west and then south.

sentences.zh: 亦據該使呈繪圖志，有順薩彥山嶺至奎屯鄂博所有界限地名。

translations.literal: It also cites the envoy's submitted maps, with boundary place names along the Sayin ridge to Kuitun Oboo.
translations.idiomatic: The envoy's maps likewise listed boundary points along the Sayin ridge as far as Kuitun Oboo.

sentences.zh: 我國舊存圖內雖無其地名，然據該使所指方向，續經庫倫辦事大臣文盛送雍正五年已定交界圖志，名目雖殊，界限大致相似。

translations.literal: Although our old maps lack these place names, according to the direction the envoy indicated, subsequently the Kobdo commissioner Wensheng sent the Yongzheng fifth year already-fixed border maps; though the names differ, the boundaries are roughly similar.
translations.idiomatic: These names did not appear on older Chinese maps, but following the route the envoy indicated, Kobdo Commissioner Wensheng later sent maps of the border fixed in Yongzheng 5. The labels differed, yet the line was much the same.

sentences.zh: 唐努烏梁海遊牧雖有被俄人包去之嫌，與西二盟遊牧無礙。

translations.literal: Though Tannu Uriankhai pastures seem to have been encircled by Russians, they do not affect the pastoral lands of the western two leagues.
translations.idiomatic: Some Tannu Uriankhai pastures might be enclosed by Russian claims, but the grazing lands of the western two leagues would not be affected.

sentences.zh: 明年立界時，俟與麟興、車林敦多布等妥商辦理。

translations.literal: When establishing the boundary next year, we shall discuss and handle it properly with Lin Xing, Charindundob, and others.
translations.idiomatic: When the boundary was set the following year, the matter would be settled in consultation with Lin Xing, Charindundob, and the others.

sentences.zh: 」四年八月，麟興等奏：「據委員岳嵩武稟報，與唐努烏梁海總管凡齊爾馳赴博果素克大壩履勘起，沿站按圖詳查，行至唐努鄂拉達巴哈，核與俄國所畫唐努鄂拉達巴哈邊界相符。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the fourth year Lin Xing and others memorialized: "According to Commissioner Yue Songwu's report, starting from an on-site survey at Bogusik Dam where he hastened to meet Tannu Uriankhai Superintendent Fanchir, proceeding station by station along the map in detailed examination, reaching Tannu Uladabaha, verified to match Russia's drawn Tannu Uladabaha boundary."
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the fourth year Lin Xing reported that Commissioner Yue Songwu, after riding to meet Superintendent Fanchir at Bogusik Dam, had surveyed the line station by station along the map and found Tannu Uladabaha matched the boundary Russia had drawn.

sentences.zh: 除薩彥山因無路徑不能履勘，其唐努鄂拉達巴哈及邊境應分之珠嚕淖爾、塔斯啟勒山、哈喇塔蘇爾山、德布色克哈山數處，擇擬立界處所，繪會勘圖志呈閱。

translations.literal: Except Sayin Mountain could not be surveyed for lack of paths, at Tannu Uladabaha and border places to be divided such as Zhulu Nor, Taskele Mountain, Khaltasur Mountain, and Debsikha Mountain, proposed boundary sites were selected and joint survey maps submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Sayin Mountain could not be walked because there was no trail. For Tannu Uladabaha and the disputed sites at Zhulu Nor, Taskele Mountain, Khaltasur Mountain, Debsikha Mountain, and elsewhere, proposed marker locations were chosen and joint survey maps submitted.

sentences.zh: 」時俄立界使臣以事不能至。

translations.literal: At the time the Russian boundary commissioner could not arrive due to affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The Russian boundary commissioner could not come at that time.

sentences.zh: 九月，明誼等以軍務緊急，請緩約俄使立界。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Mingyi and others, because military affairs were urgent, requested postponing the boundary treaty with the Russian envoy.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Mingyi and his colleagues, citing urgent military affairs, asked to postpone the boundary negotiations with Russia.

sentences.zh: 六年，俄人遂越界至總管邁達爾遊牧內烏克果勒地方建屋種地。

translations.literal: In the sixth year Russians then crossed the boundary to Ukugol within Superintendent Maidar's pastures and built houses and planted fields.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year Russians crossed the line into Ukugol within Superintendent Maidar's pastures and built houses and planted fields.

sentences.zh: 總理各國事務衙門照會俄使，始由庫倫俄官行文令送之回國。

translations.literal: The Zongli Yamen protested to the Russian envoy; only then did the Kobdo Russian official send documents ordering them sent back to their country.
translations.idiomatic: The Zongli Yamen protested to the Russian minister, and only then did the Russian official at Kobdo order the intruders sent home.

sentences.zh: 是年，廷旨促麟興等建立西疆毗連俄境界牌鄂博。

translations.literal: That year court edicts urged Lin Xing and others to establish western frontier boundary markers and cairns adjoining Russia.
translations.idiomatic: That year the court ordered Lin Xing and others to erect boundary markers and cairns along the western frontier adjoining Russia.

sentences.zh: 六月，專命榮全迅與俄官會立烏裏雅蘇台邊卡界牌鄂博。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Rongquan was specially ordered to hasten joint erection of Uliassutai border pickets, markers, and cairns with Russian officials.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Rongquan was specially ordered to hurry to Uliassutai and set up border pickets, markers, and cairns with Russian officials.

sentences.zh: 八年五月，榮全與俄使穆魯木策夫至是部西南之賽留格木山嶺會立牌博，於是月二十六日起行，順賽留格木嶺至是部西南邊境盡處之博果蘇克壩，立第一界牌鄂博，科城立牌博於南，俄國立牌博於西。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the eighth year Rongquan and Russian envoy Murunov came to Sairiugem ridge on the southwest of this department to erect markers; starting on the twenty-sixth of that month, following Sairiugem ridge to Bogusuk Dam at the department's southwestern border extremity, the first boundary marker was erected; Qing erected markers on the south, Russia on the west.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the eighth year Rongquan and the Russian envoy Murunov met on the Sairiugem ridge in the southwest of the region to set markers. They began on the twenty-sixth, followed the ridge to Bogusuk Dam at the southwestern tip, and raised the first marker, with Qing markers to the south and Russian markers to the west.

sentences.zh: 由此向東北約八十里，名塔斯啟勒山，於山頂立第二牌博。

translations.literal: From here northeast about eighty li, called Taskele Mountain, a second marker was erected on the summit.
translations.idiomatic: About eighty li northeast lay Taskele Mountain, where a second marker was placed on the summit.

sentences.zh: 又向東北約九十里，至珠嚕淖爾，俄使言只就珠嚕淖爾迤北數十里唐努山之察布齊雅壩止，建立鄂博，由此直向西北，統至沙賓達巴哈，路既便捷，尤易行走。

translations.literal: Another ninety li northeast to Zhulu Nor; the Russian envoy said only from north of Zhulu Nor several tens of li at Chabu Qiya Dam on Tannu Mountain, erect cairns, then straight northwest to Shabindaba—the route being convenient and especially easy to travel.
translations.idiomatic: Another ninety li northeast brought them to Zhulu Nor. The Russian envoy proposed markers only from a point north of the lake, at Chabu Qiya Dam on the Tannu range, then straight northwest to Shabindaba—a shorter and easier route.

sentences.zh: 榮全以俄使所指之路俱系是部遊牧內地，若照俄使所議，不惟與原圖大不相符，且將是部遊牧包去大半，向俄使反復開導，仍如原圖，於珠嚕淖爾東南之哈爾根山立第三牌博。

translations.literal: Rongquan said the routes the Russian envoy indicated were all within this department's pastoral interior; if following the Russian envoy's proposal, not only would it greatly differ from the original map but would encircle most of the department's pastures; after repeatedly instructing the Russian envoy, still according to the original map, a third marker was erected on Khargen Mountain southeast of Zhulu Nor.
translations.idiomatic: Rongquan replied that every route the Russians named lay inside the department's own pastures. Accepting their line would not only diverge sharply from the old map but would cut off most of the grazing lands. After repeated argument he held to the original map and set the third marker on Khargen Mountain southeast of Zhulu Nor.

sentences.zh: 順淖爾北岸約二十餘里，至唐努山南察布齊雅壩，立第四牌博。

translations.literal: About twenty-odd li along the north shore of the nor to Chabu Qiya Dam on the south of Tannu Mountain, the fourth marker was erected.
translations.idiomatic: Following the north shore of the lake for some twenty li, they reached Chabu Qiya Dam on the southern face of the Tannu range and raised the fourth marker.

sentences.zh: 沿唐努山南，向西過莫多圖河、紮勒都倫河、烏爾圖河、察罕紮克蘇圖河，順哈喇塔蘇爾海山，至沙克魯河，轉向東北約二百五十餘里，至庫色爾壩，系是部西方邊界，立第五牌博。

translations.literal: Along the south of Tannu west past Modutu, Zhalduun, Urtu, and Chahan Zakusu rivers, following Khartasurhai Mountain to Shakuru River, turning northeast about 250 li to Kuseer Dam at the department's western border, the fifth marker was erected.
translations.idiomatic: They traced the southern slope of the Tannu range west across the Modutu, Zhalduun, Urtu, and Chahan Zakusu rivers, followed Khartasurhai Mountain to the Shakuru River, turned northeast for about 250 li to Kuseer Dam on the department's western edge, and set the fifth marker.

sentences.zh: 向西北九十餘里，至唐努鄂拉達巴哈末處，過哈喇河偏西山下楚拉察水流之處，立第六牌博。

translations.literal: Northwest ninety-odd li to the end of Tannu Uladabaha, past the Khara River to the place on the western slope of the mountain where the Chulacha stream flows, the sixth marker was erected.
translations.idiomatic: Ninety-odd li northwest brought them to the end of Tannu Uladabaha, where the Chulacha stream runs below the western slope of the Khara River valley; there they set the sixth marker.

sentences.zh: 向北又東，順薩彥山過瑪納瑚河、蒙納克河、浩拉什河，由喀喇淖爾至蘇爾大壩，約一百五十里，立第七牌博。

translations.literal: North then east along Sayin Mountain past Mana, Monak, and Holash rivers, from Khara Nor to Sur Dam about 150 li, the seventh marker was erected.
translations.idiomatic: Turning north and then east along the Sayin range, they crossed the Mana, Monak, and Holash rivers, went from Khara Nor to Sur Dam for about 150 li, and erected the seventh marker.

sentences.zh: 向北又東約三百六十餘里，山脈連貫，直至沙賓達巴哈，於舊牌博之東山頂上立第八牌博。

translations.literal: North then east about 360 li, mountains continuous to Shabindaba, the eighth marker was erected on the hilltop east of the old marker.
translations.idiomatic: Another 360 li north and east along the unbroken ridge brought them to Shabindaba, where the eighth marker was placed on the hill east of the old cairn.

sentences.zh: 照原圖至賽留格木山博果蘇克壩上，紅線以左為中國地，紅線以右為俄國地。

translations.literal: Per original map to Bogusuk Dam on Sairiugem Mountain, left of red line China, right Russia.
translations.idiomatic: According to the original map as far as Bogusuk Dam on the Sairiugem range, land to the left of the red line was Chinese and land to the right was Russian.

sentences.zh: 至六月二十二日竣事，而是部阿勒泰河、阿穆哈河區域皆入於俄。

translations.literal: Completed on the twenty-second of the sixth month, but this department's Altai River and Amukha River regions all entered Russia.
translations.idiomatic: The work was finished on the twenty-second day of the sixth month, yet the Altai River and Amukha River districts of the region had all passed to Russia.

sentences.zh: 光緒五年，烏裏雅蘇台將軍以奇木齊克河總管報俄商在唐努烏梁海屬建蓋行棧數處，及春季以來，有俄人或三五十人或八九十人不等，在奇木齊克河北一帶中唐努山內刨挖金砂，例應禁止，咨總理各國事務衙門照會俄署使凱陽德轉飭邊官查禁。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Guangxu the Uliassutai general reported from the Kimchik River superintendent that Russian merchants had built several trading stations in Tannu Uriankhai territory, and since spring groups of thirty to fifty or eighty to ninety Russians had been digging gold within the Tannu Mountains north of the Kimchik River, which should be forbidden; he consulted the Zongli Yamen to protest to Russian minister Kayangde to order border officials to investigate and forbid.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 5 the Uliassutai general relayed a report from the Kimchik River superintendent that Russian merchants had opened several trading posts in Tannu Uriankhai territory and that since spring bands of thirty to ninety Russians had been panning gold inside the Tannu range north of the Kimchik River. The practice was illegal, and the Zongli Yamen was asked to notify Minister Kayangde so border officials could stop it.

sentences.zh: 七年五月，烏裏雅蘇台將軍以俄人在薩爾魯克地方居住，紮立木棚十處，附近挖過金砂大小凡一百餘處，照會俄駐庫領事迅飭邊界官嚴禁。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the seventh year the Uliassutai general reported Russians dwelling at Sarluuk, erecting ten wooden sheds, with over a hundred large and small gold diggings nearby, protesting to the Russian consul at Kobdo to order border officials to strictly forbid.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the seventh year the Uliassutai general reported Russians living at Sarluuk, ten wooden huts, and more than a hundred gold pits nearby. He asked the Russian consul at Kobdo to order border officials to enforce the ban.

sentences.zh: 十四年四月，烏裏雅蘇台將軍杜嘎爾奏稱：「所轄唐努烏梁海屬地邊外自柏郭蘇克西北至沙賓達巴罕，中國設立界牌，每年夏季派員會同查閱。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the fourteenth year Uliassutai General Dugar memorialized: "Within the territory under my jurisdiction of Tannu Uriankhai, beyond the border from Bogusuk northwest to Shabindaba, China has established boundary markers, each summer dispatching officers jointly to inspect."
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the fourteenth year Uliassutai General Dugar reported that from Bogusuk northwest to Shabindaba along the outer edge of Tannu Uriankhai territory China had set boundary markers, inspected each summer by joint parties.

sentences.zh: 其嶺一東一南，至烏裏雅蘇台，即嶺之左，歸中國屬，載在條約。

translations.literal: The ridge runs one east one south to Uliassutai; that is, to the left of the ridge belongs to China, as recorded in the treaty.
translations.idiomatic: The ridge runs east and south toward Uliassutai. Land to the left of the ridge belongs to China, as the treaty states.

sentences.zh: 乃俄人竟於沙賓達巴罕以東，霍呢章達巴罕以西，唐努所屬爾裏黨、薩布塔爾、都不達果勒、車爾裏克、荊格等河岸地方，前經查驗過俄人挖金共四十五處，至今仍在薩布塔爾、車爾裏克兩處附近河岸開挖甚多。

translations.literal: Yet Russians actually east of Shabindaba and west of Khoniin Jabindaba, at riverbank places of Erlidang, Sabutar, Budadagor, Cherik, Jingge and others belonging to Tannu, previously inspected with forty-five Russian gold diggings, still today extensively digging near the banks at Sabutar and Cherik.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Russians had moved east of Shabindaba and west of Khoniin Jabindaba along the Erlidang, Sabutar, Budadagor, Cherik, Jingge, and other rivers under Tannu jurisdiction. Earlier inspections had found forty-five gold pits; digging was still heavy near Sabutar and Cherik.

sentences.zh: 烏克、多倫兩河地方，俄人明固賴等任意開墾地畝，長一千三百餘廣尺，寬八百二十餘廣尺。

translations.literal: At Uk and Doron two river places, Russians Minggulai and others arbitrarily opened fields measuring over 1,300 chang in length and over 820 chang in width.
translations.idiomatic: Along the Uk and Doron rivers Russians such as Minggulai had cleared fields more than 1,300 chang long and 820 chang wide.

sentences.zh: 俄人雅固爾等於薩拉塔木、博木、額奇布拉克、多倫、烏克、車爾裏克、托勒博、薩斯多克、密崗嚕勒、紮庫勒、哈達努額奇依斯克、木阿瑪、阿克河口、吉爾噶琥河口、吉爾紮拉克等十五處建蓋堅屋，南入我境至數百之多。

translations.literal: Russians Yagur and others at fifteen places including Salatamu, Bomu, Eqi Bulak, Doron, Uk, Cherik, Tolebo, Sasdok, Miganglule, Zhakule, Hadanu Eqiyisk, Muama, Ak River mouth, Jiergahu River mouth, and Jierzhalak built solid houses, penetrating south into our territory by the hundreds.
translations.idiomatic: Russians such as Yagur had built solid houses at fifteen sites—Salatamu, Bomu, Eqi Bulak, Doron, Uk, Cherik, Tolebo, Sasdok, Miganglule, Zhakule, Hadanu Eqiyisk, Muama, the mouths of the Ak and Jiergahu rivers, Jierzhalak, and others—hundreds of them deep inside Chinese territory.

sentences.zh: 本年派佐領榮昌等往烏梁海吉爾拉裏克地方會俄官辯論挖金、蓋房、種地各案，俄官一味支吾，執意不辦，應由總理各國事務衙門逐件查覆。

translations.literal: This year Assistant Commandant Rongchang and others were dispatched to Uriankhai Jierlalik to meet Russian officials to debate gold digging, building houses, and planting fields cases; Russian officials only equivocated and stubbornly refused to act; the Zongli Yamen should investigate each item.
translations.idiomatic: That year Assistant Commandant Rongchang was sent to Jierlalik in Uriankhai to meet Russian officials over gold digging, house building, and farming. The Russians stalled and refused to act. The Zongli Yamen should take up each case.

sentences.zh: 」旋由總理事務衙門覆奏：「請飭將軍等詳勘界限，研究根由，援據約章，與俄酋竭力辯論。

translations.literal: Soon the Zongli Yamen memorialized in reply: "Order the general and others to survey the boundary in detail, study the root causes, cite treaty provisions, and debate strenuously with Russian chiefs."
translations.idiomatic: The Zongli Yamen soon replied that the general should survey the boundary, trace the causes, cite the treaties, and press the Russian authorities as hard as possible.

sentences.zh: 倘彼堅執，或應知照駐俄使臣，嚴請外部妥籌辦法，或即估給蓋房之費，令從速遷徙，由將軍等就近相機籌定，奏明辦理。

translations.literal: If they stubbornly persist, either notify the minister stationed in Russia to strictly request the foreign ministry to devise proper methods, or immediately estimate and pay house-building costs and order swift relocation, to be decided nearby by the general and others and memorialized for handling.
translations.idiomatic: If the Russians held firm, the minister in St. Petersburg might be told to demand a remedy from the foreign ministry, or the cost of the houses might be paid to secure a quick withdrawal—whatever the general judged best on the spot, to be reported and carried out.

sentences.zh: 」十月，祥麟等奏覆派吉玉等由烏梁海印務處於六月自廕木噶拉泰起程，履勘車爾裏克等處，往返兩月有餘，已將俄人在境內挖金、蓋房、種地三事詳細查明，繕單入告。

translations.literal: In the tenth month Xianglin and others memorialized in reply that Jiyu and others dispatched from the Uriankhai seal office departed in the sixth month from Yinmugalatai, surveyed Cherik and other places, returning after more than two months, having thoroughly investigated the three matters of Russians digging gold, building houses, and planting fields within the territory, compiled lists and reported.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Xianglin reported that Jiyu and others had left the Uriankhai seal office in the sixth month from Yinmugalatai, spent more than two months surveying Cherik and other sites, and submitted a detailed list of Russian gold digging, construction, and farming inside the border.

sentences.zh: 命總理各國事務衙門照會俄使，將越界在唐努烏梁海挖金、蓋房、種地之背約俄人遷回本國。

translations.literal: Ordered the Zongli Yamen to protest to the Russian envoy to relocate treaty-breaking Russians who crossed the boundary to dig gold, build houses, and plant fields in Tannu Uriankhai back to their country.
translations.idiomatic: The Zongli Yamen was ordered to notify the Russian minister that Russians who had crossed into Tannu Uriankhai to mine, build, or farm in violation of treaty must be sent home.

sentences.zh: 二十五年八月，烏裏雅蘇台參贊大臣志銳以奇木齊克河總管請給印奏入，命連順察看情形，奏明辦理。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the twenty-fifth year Uliassutai assistant minister Zhirui memorialized that the Kimchik River superintendent requested a seal; ordered Lianshun to inspect the situation and memorialized for handling.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the twenty-fifth year Assistant Minister Zhirui of Uliassutai reported the Kimchik River superintendent's request for an official seal. Lianshun was told to inspect conditions and report back.

sentences.zh: 尋覆奏，以「奇木齊克河與唐努總管相隔實在千里之外，中間橫亙賽音諾顏部之額魯特扎薩克貝子達克丹多爾濟所屬烏梁海，遇有齟<齒吾>，文報不通，凡事轉報總管，未能直達烏城。

translations.literal: Soon memorialized in reply that "Kimchik River and Tannu superintendent are actually separated by over a thousand li, with Sayn Noyan Banner Oirat zasaghtu prince Dakdan Dorji's Uriankhai interposed between; when there are disputes, documents do not pass, all matters relayed through the superintendent cannot reach Uliassutai directly."
translations.idiomatic: Lianshun soon replied that Kimchik River lay more than a thousand li from the Tannu superintendent, with Uriankhai under the Sayn Noyan Oirat prince Dakdan Dorji in between. When disputes arose, papers could not get through, and nothing reached Uliassutai except by relay through the Tannu superintendent.

sentences.zh: 奇木齊克河實有二千一十三戶，丁口已幾萬人。

translations.literal: Kimchik River actually has 2,013 households, population already nearly tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: Kimchik River had 2,013 households and a population of nearly ten thousand.

sentences.zh: 唐努總管每年勒派各情，亦所恆有。

translations.literal: The Tannu superintendent's annual exactions of various kinds are also constant.
translations.idiomatic: The Tannu superintendent's yearly levies were a constant grievance.

sentences.zh: 其他毗連俄界，交涉事多。

translations.literal: Moreover it borders Russia, with many frontier affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The region also bordered Russia and faced frequent frontier disputes.

sentences.zh: 既，十蘇木連結懇求，是與唐努總管其心已離，兩不相下，倘有事故，亦難收拾。

translations.literal: Moreover ten somon united in earnest pleading; their hearts have already parted from the Tannu superintendent, neither yielding to the other; if an incident occurs, it will also be hard to manage.
translations.idiomatic: All ten somon had joined in petitioning. They were already estranged from the Tannu superintendent and would not submit to one another; any incident would be hard to control.

sentences.zh: 若將數十年仰希朝廷之恩，一旦下頒，必能自固籓籬，為我遮罩。

translations.literal: If after decades looking up to court grace, a seal is suddenly granted, they will surely be able to secure their own frontier fence and shield for us.
translations.idiomatic: After decades of looking to the court for favor, granting a seal at once would let them hold their own frontier line and serve as a buffer for the empire.

sentences.zh: 況有東烏梁海請印在前，似難以不符體制為解，請仍賞給印信」。

translations.literal: Moreover with eastern Uriankhai requesting seals previously, it seems hard to explain by not conforming to regulations; request still to grant a seal.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Uriankhai had already received seals, so refusing on grounds of precedent was weak. He asked that a seal be granted after all.

sentences.zh: 得旨，如所請。

translations.literal: Received imperial assent, as requested.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，詔連順等備邊。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year edict ordered Lianshun and others to prepare the border.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year Lianshun and others were ordered to prepare frontier defenses.

sentences.zh: 時拳匪事起，中外人心惶惑。

translations.literal: At the time the Boxer affair arose, Chinese and foreign hearts were alarmed and confused.
translations.idiomatic: The Boxer rising had begun, and Chinese and foreigners alike were unsettled.

sentences.zh: 連順檄唐努烏梁海總管棍布多爾濟、薩拉吉克烏梁海總管巴勒錦呢瑪、托錦烏梁海總管淩魁、庫布蘇庫勒諾爾烏梁海總管克什克濟爾噶勒、奇木齊克河烏梁海總管海都布調兵練團，嚴密舉辦。

translations.literal: Lianshun ordered Tannu Uriankhai Superintendent Gunbudorji, Sarajik Uriankhai Superintendent Balejinima, Tojin Uriankhai Superintendent Lingkui, Kubsugul Nor Uriankhai Superintendent Keshikjiergal, and Kimchik River Uriankhai Superintendent Haidubu to mobilize troops and drill militia, strictly carried out.
translations.idiomatic: Lianshun instructed the Tannu superintendent Gunbudorji, the Sarajik superintendent Balejinima, the Tojin superintendent Lingkui, the Kubsugul Nor superintendent Keshikjiergal, and the Kimchik River superintendent Haidubu to raise troops and drill militia without delay.

sentences.zh: 棍布多爾濟等均能刻日成軍。

translations.literal: Gunbudorji and others were all able to form armies within days.
translations.idiomatic: Gunbudorji and the others had their forces ready within days.

sentences.zh: 復籌幫軍食，擇要加兵防守，善待俄商，毋生邊釁。

translations.literal: Also planned army provisions, selected key points to add troops for defense, treat Russian merchants well, do not provoke border incidents.
translations.idiomatic: He also arranged supplies, reinforced key posts, and told them to treat Russian merchants well and avoid provoking border clashes.

sentences.zh: 二十八年十二月，連順等再請獎敘，疏入，予克什克濟爾噶勒二品頂戴，海都布二品花翎。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the twenty-eighth year Lianshun and others again requested rewards; memorial entered, granted Keshikjiergal second-rank cap button, Haidubu second-rank peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the twenty-eighth year Lianshun again asked for rewards. Keshikjiergal received a second-rank cap button and Haidubu a second-rank peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 是年，連順以「烏梁海向風沐化幾二百年，直與喀爾喀蒙古無異。

translations.literal: That year Lianshun said: "Uriankhai have faced the transforming winds nearly two hundred years, directly no different from Khalkha Mongols."
translations.idiomatic: That year Lianshun wrote that the Uriankhai had been under imperial civilization for nearly two hundred years and were scarcely different from the Khalkha Mongols.

sentences.zh: 我國商民仍守舊規，不敢違禁潛往貿易。

translations.literal: Our country's merchants still observe old regulations, not daring to violate prohibitions and secretly go trade.
translations.idiomatic: Chinese traders still obeyed the old rules and did not slip across the border to trade in secret.

sentences.zh: 至俄商之在烏梁海貿易者，不計其數，建蓋房屋，常年居住，每年收買鹿茸、狐、狼、水獺、猞猁猻、貂皮、灰鼠，為款甚钜，致烏梁海來烏城呈交貢皮時，竟至無貨可以貿易。

translations.literal: As for Russian merchants trading in Uriankhai, countless in number, building houses and residing year-round, each year buying antler velvet, fox, wolf, otter, lynx, sable, and squirrel pelts in huge sums, causing when Uriankhai come to Uliassutai to present tribute pelts there is actually no goods left to trade.
translations.idiomatic: Russian traders in Uriankhai, by contrast, were beyond count. They built houses and lived there year-round, buying up antler velvet, fox, wolf, otter, lynx, sable, and squirrel pelts in enormous quantities. When Uriankhai came to Uliassutai to present tribute furs, they often had nothing left to exchange.

sentences.zh: 惟有變通辦理，如在烏城貿易商民原赴烏梁海貿易者，准即報官前往，仍由將軍衙門照章酌給六個月限票，並嚴飭守卡官兵認真稽查，不准挾帶違禁之物」。

translations.literal: Only flexible handling: if merchants trading at Uliassutai originally went to Uriankhai to trade, permit them to report to officials and go, still by the general's office according to regulations issue six-month limit passes, and strictly order garrison troops at checkpoints to inspect earnestly, not permitting carrying prohibited goods.
translations.idiomatic: The only remedy was flexibility: merchants at Uliassutai who had formerly traded in Uriankhai might register with officials and go, still receiving six-month passes from the general's office as regulations provided, while checkpoint troops were ordered to search carefully for contraband.

sentences.zh: 允之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: This was approved.

sentences.zh: 宣統元年，烏裏雅蘇台將軍堃岫等以奇木齊克河總管海都布率奏本旗十蘇木公揀海都布長子達魯噶布音巴達爾琥辦事勤能，眾心傾服，請補總管，允之。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xuantong Uliassutai General Kunxiu and others reported that Kimchik River Superintendent Haidubu led the ten somon of this banner in jointly selecting Haidubu's eldest son Darugabuyin Badarhu as diligent and capable in affairs, winning popular devotion, requesting to fill the superintendent post; approved.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuantong 1 Uliassutai General Kunxiu reported that Kimchik River Superintendent Haidubu and the ten somon of the banner had chosen his eldest son Darugabuyin Badarhu as diligent, capable, and widely trusted, and asked that he succeed as superintendent. The appointment was granted.

sentences.zh: 是部天和土腴，有灌溉之利，宜麥。

translations.literal: This department has mild climate and fertile soil, with irrigation benefits, suitable for wheat.
translations.idiomatic: The region enjoyed a mild climate and fertile soil with irrigation, and wheat grew well there.

sentences.zh: 有金、銅、石棉諸礦，林木亦富。

translations.literal: There are gold, copper, asbestos and other mines; timber is also abundant.
translations.idiomatic: It held gold, copper, asbestos, and other minerals, and its forests were rich.

sentences.zh: 達布遜山產石鹽，是部全境及科布多北部皆資之。

translations.literal: Dabuxun Mountain produces rock salt; the entire department and northern Kobdo all rely on it.
translations.idiomatic: Dabuxun Mountain yielded rock salt on which the whole department and northern Kobdo depended.

sentences.zh: 唐努、薩拉吉克、托錦三總管各有佐領四，庫布蘇庫勒諾爾總管佐領二，奇木齊克河總管佐領十。

translations.literal: Tannu, Sarajik, and Tojin three superintendents each have four assistant commandants; Kubsugul Nor superintendent has two assistant commandants; Kimchik River superintendent has ten assistant commandants.
translations.idiomatic: The Tannu, Sarajik, and Tojin superintendents each had four assistant commandants; Kubsugul Nor had two; and Kimchik River had ten.

sentences.zh: 薩拉吉克別名薩爾吉格，托錦別名陶吉，總管皆無印。

translations.literal: Sarajik is also called Sarjige, Tojin is also called Taoji; the superintendents all have no seals.
translations.idiomatic: Sarajik was also known as Sarjige and Tojin as Taoji. Their superintendents held no official seals.

sentences.zh: 庫布蘇庫勒諾爾別名庫蘇古淖爾，奇木齊克河別名肯木次克，有印。

translations.literal: Kubsugul Nor is also called Kusugu Nor, Kimchik River is also called Kenmucike; they have seals.
translations.idiomatic: Kubsugul Nor was also called Kusugu Nor and Kimchik River Kenmucike. Their superintendents did hold seals.

sentences.zh: 此外扎薩克圖汗部右翼右旗有五佐領：一在庫蘇古爾泊北，一在華克穆河東北，一在格德勒爾河西，一在謨什克河西，一在紮庫爾河源。

translations.literal: Moreover the Zasaghtu Khan Banner right wing right banner has five assistant commandants: one north of Kusugu Lake, one northeast of Khakmu River, one west of Gedeler River, one west of Moshike River, one at the source of Zhakur River.
translations.idiomatic: The Zasaghtu Khan Banner's right-wing right banner had five assistant commandants: north of Kusugu Lake, northeast of the Khakmu River, west of the Gedeler River, west of the Moshike River, and at the headwaters of the Zhakur River.

sentences.zh: 賽音諾顏部額魯特貝子旗佐領十三，皆南依鄂爾噶汗山，西接阿勒泰淖爾烏梁海。

translations.literal: The Sayn Noyan Banner Oirat prince banner has thirteen assistant commandants, all south along Mount Erge Khan, west adjoining Altai Nuur Uriankhai.
translations.idiomatic: The Sayn Noyan Oirat prince banner had thirteen assistant commandants along the southern face of Mount Erge Khan, bordering Altai Nuur Uriankhai to the west.

sentences.zh: 哲布尊丹巴呼圖克圖徒眾所屬佐領三，西臨華克穆河。

translations.literal: Three assistant commandants belonging to the disciples of Jebzundamba Khutuktu, west facing Khakmu River.
translations.idiomatic: Three assistant commandants under the Jebzundamba Khutuktu's followers lay along the Khakmu River to the west.

sentences.zh: 阿勒泰烏梁海，在科布多之西，東額魯特，東南紮哈沁及布勒罕河新土爾扈特、哈弼察克新和碩特，南和博克薩里舊土爾扈特，東北杜爾伯特，北阿勒泰淖爾烏梁海。

translations.literal: Altai Uriankhai lies west of Kobdo, east Oirat, southeast Zhakhin and Bulgan River new Torghut and Khabchak new Khoshut, south Hoboksar old Torghut, northeast Dorbed, north Altai Nuur Uriankhai.
translations.idiomatic: The Altai Uriankhai lay west of Kobdo, with the Oirats to the east, Zhakhin and the new Torghut and Khoshut of the Bulgan River to the southeast, the old Torghut of Hoboksar to the south, the Dorbed to the northeast, and Altai Nuur Uriankhai to the north.

sentences.zh: 分左右翼，左翼旗四，右翼旗三。

translations.literal: Divided into left and right wings, left wing four banners, right wing three banners.
translations.idiomatic: The people were organized into a left wing of four banners and a right wing of three.

sentences.zh: 初屬準噶爾。

translations.literal: Initially subordinate to the Dzungars.
translations.idiomatic: They had originally belonged to the Dzungars.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十八年，喀爾喀扎薩克圖汗等台吉達什朋素克隨北路軍營參贊大臣薩喇爾擒私入科布多汛之烏梁海人紮木圖等。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year of Qianlong Khalkha Zasaghtu Khan and other taiji Dashpungsuk accompanied northern route army camp assistant minister Sarlar in capturing Uriankhai Zhamtu and others who had privately entered the Kobdo patrol border.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 18 the Khalkha Zasaghtu Khan and other taiji, including Dashpungsuk, joined Assistant Minister Sarlar of the northern army in seizing the Uriankhai Zhamtu and others who had crossed the Kobdo patrol line.

sentences.zh: 十九年正月，命薩喇爾等統兵征入卡之準噶爾屬烏梁海。

translations.literal: In the first month of the nineteenth year ordered Sarlar and others to command troops to campaign against Dzungar-subject Uriankhai who had entered the border pass.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the nineteenth year Sarlar and others were ordered to march against Dzungar Uriankhai who had entered the border passes.

sentences.zh: 釋北路軍營誘捕之烏梁海禡木特等，令回部落。

translations.literal: Released northern route army camp lured-and-captured Uriankhai Mamut and others, ordering them to return to their tribes.
translations.idiomatic: Uriankhai such as Mamut, whom the northern army had lured into capture, were released and sent back to their tribes.

sentences.zh: 二月，準噶爾烏梁海庫木來降。

translations.literal: In the second month Dzungar Uriankhai Kumlai submitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month the Dzungar Uriankhai leader Kumlai surrendered.

sentences.zh: 三月，命舒赫德赴卓克索地方會薩喇爾招撫烏梁海。

translations.literal: In the third month ordered Shuhede to go to Zhuokeso place to meet Sarlar in winning over Uriankhai.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Shuhede was sent to Zhuokeso to join Sarlar in winning over the Uriankhai.

sentences.zh: 尋以烏梁海徙牧額爾齊斯等地，令暫撤兵。

translations.literal: Soon because Uriankhai moved pastures to Irtysh and other places, ordered temporary withdrawal of troops.
translations.idiomatic: When the Uriankhai shifted their herds toward the Irtysh and elsewhere, the troops were ordered to withdraw for the time being.

sentences.zh: 是月，以收撫烏梁海，移北路軍營於烏裏雅蘇台。

translations.literal: That month, because of winning over Uriankhai, moved the northern route army camp to Uliassutai.
translations.idiomatic: That same month the northern army camp was moved to Uliassutai to consolidate control over the Uriankhai.

sentences.zh: 七月，賽音諾顏貝子車木楚克紮布暨班第、薩喇爾等擊烏梁海宰桑於察罕烏蘇，降之。

translations.literal: In the seventh month Sayn Noyan prince Chemchukzhab and Bandi, Sarlar and others attacked Uriankhai zaisang at Chahan Usu and made them submit.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Prince Chemchukzhab of Sayn Noyan, together with Bandi and Sarlar, defeated Uriankhai zaisang at Chahan Usu and accepted their submission.

sentences.zh: 十月，班第、薩喇爾進兵降阿勒泰居住之準噶爾烏梁海宰桑禡木特及通禡木特，收戶口千餘。

translations.literal: In the tenth month Bandi and Sarlar advanced troops to subdue Dzungar Uriankhai zaisang Mamut and Tongmamut dwelling at Altai, receiving over a thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Bandi and Sarlar advanced into the Altai and subdued the Dzungar zaisang Mamut and Tongmamut, bringing in more than a thousand households.

sentences.zh: 復由阿勒泰赴索爾畢嶺，進至布林漢之察漢托輝額貝和碩地方，獲宰桑庫克新等。

translations.literal: Again from Altai went to Solbi ridge, advanced to Chahan Tohui Ebe Khoshoo place of Bulgan, obtaining zaisang Kukxin and others.
translations.idiomatic: They then marched from the Altai to Solbi ridge and on to Bulgan's Chahan Tohui Ebe Khoshoo, capturing zaisang including Kukxin.

sentences.zh: 十一月，以收撫烏梁海，加和托輝特貝勒青袞咱卜郡王銜，編設烏梁海人戶旗分佐領，諭授宰桑車根、赤倫、察達克總管，命庫克新於額爾齊斯屯田。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month because of winning over Uriankhai, added Khotoi Khotogo beile Chingunjab prince rank, organized Uriankhai households into banners and assistant commandants, ordered granting zaisang Chergen, Chilen, Chadak as superintendents, ordered Kukxin to farm at Irtysh.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Chingunjab of Khotoi Khotogo was raised to prince for his role in winning over the Uriankhai. Uriankhai households were organized into banners and assistant commandants; zaisang Chergen, Chilen, and Chadak were made superintendents, and Kukxin was ordered to farm on the Irtysh.

sentences.zh: 二十年正月，察達克等兵至華額爾齊斯河收穫包沁宰桑等。

translations.literal: In the first month of the twentieth year Chadak and others' troops reached Khware Irtysh River and harvested capturing Baoxin zaisang and others.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the twentieth year Chadak's troops reached the Khware Irtysh and took the Baoxin zaisang and others.

sentences.zh: 授察達克副都統，予烏梁海總管赤倫副都統銜，命招撫汗哈屯之烏梁海人眾。

translations.literal: Granted Chadak vice commander-in-chief rank, gave Uriankhai superintendent Chilen vice commander-in-chief rank, ordered to win over Uriankhai people of Khan Khoto.
translations.idiomatic: Chadak was made a vice commander-in-chief, Uriankhai superintendent Chilen received the same rank, and both were told to win over the Uriankhai of Khan Khoto.

sentences.zh: 免烏梁海等貢賦一年。

translations.literal: Exempted Uriankhai and others from tribute for one year.
translations.idiomatic: Uriankhai tribute was remitted for one year.

sentences.zh: 二月，編察達克、赤倫所屬烏梁海為佐領七。

translations.literal: In the second month organized Uriankhai under Chadak and Chilen into seven assistant commandants.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month the Uriankhai under Chadak and Chilen were divided into seven assistant commandant districts.

sentences.zh: 三月，烏梁海宰桑都塔齊以指示投順之人逃竄正法，命扎薩克圖汗部扎薩克台吉根敦等駐防海喇圖、科布多等處，管烏梁海遊牧，接收降人。

translations.literal: In the third month Uriankhai zaisang Dutachi was executed by law for indicating that submitted persons had fled, ordered Zasaghtu Khan Banner zasaghtu taiji Gendun and others to garrison Hairatu, Kobdo and other places, managing Uriankhai pastures and receiving submitters.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month the zaisang Dutachi was executed for letting submitted Uriankhai escape. Gendun and other zasaghtu taiji of the Zasaghtu Khan Banner were posted at Hairatu and Kobdo to oversee pastures and receive new submitters.

sentences.zh: 四月，汗哈屯地方烏梁海歸順。

translations.literal: In the fourth month Uriankhai at Khan Khoto place submitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month the Uriankhai of Khan Khoto submitted.

sentences.zh: 五月，授歸順之烏梁海宰桑圖布新為總管。

translations.literal: In the fifth month granted submitting Uriankhai zaisang Tubxin as superintendent.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month the submitting zaisang Tubxin was appointed superintendent.

sentences.zh: 十月，以烏梁海出牲畜接濟哈達哈西進之軍，嘉賚之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month because Uriankhai supplied livestock to relieve the army advancing to Khadaha, rewarded them.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month the Uriankhai were rewarded for supplying livestock to armies marching toward Khadaha.

sentences.zh: 二十一年三月，以阿逆煽動烏梁海，哈薩克道梗。

translations.literal: In the third month of the twenty-first year because the rebel stirred up Uriankhai, the Kazakh route was blocked.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the twenty-first year the rebel's agitation among the Uriankhai blocked the Kazakh trade route.

sentences.zh: 詔哈達哈剿烏梁海叛賊。

translations.literal: Edict ordered Khadaha to suppress Uriankhai rebel bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Khadaha was ordered to suppress rebellious Uriankhai.

sentences.zh: 有固爾班和卓者，奇爾吉斯宰桑，攜千餘戶潛赴烏梁海，賽音諾顏郡王車布登紮布及車登三丕勒邀擒之。

translations.literal: There was one Gurban Khoja, Kirghiz zaisang, who with over a thousand households secretly went to Uriankhai; Sayn Noyan prince Chobdenzhab and Ceden Sanple invited and captured him.
translations.idiomatic: A Kirghiz zaisang named Gurban Khoja brought more than a thousand households secretly into Uriankhai territory. Sayn Noyan Prince Chobdenzhab and Ceden Sanple intercepted and captured him.

sentences.zh: 六月，青袞咱卜叛，誘新舊烏梁海附己。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Chingunjab rebelled, enticing new and old Uriankhai to join him.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Chingunjab rebelled and tried to draw both new and old Uriankhai to his side.

sentences.zh: 大兵至，皆來效順。

translations.literal: When the grand army arrived, all came to submit.
translations.idiomatic: When imperial troops arrived, they all returned to allegiance.

sentences.zh: 十月，以新舊烏梁海等備兵請討青袞咱卜，嘉賚之，授察達克內大臣。

translations.literal: In the tenth month because new and old Uriankhai and others prepared troops requesting to attack Chingunjab, rewarded them, granted Chadak grand minister rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month the new and old Uriankhai were rewarded for offering troops against Chingunjab, and Chadak was made a grand minister.

sentences.zh: 二十二年二月，命察達克等防範准部叛賊達什車淩等逃入烏梁海。

translations.literal: In the second month of the twenty-second year ordered Chadak and others to guard against Dzungar rebel bandit Dashi Celing and others fleeing into Uriankhai.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the twenty-second year Chadak and others were ordered to block Dzungar rebels such as Dashi Celing from fleeing into Uriankhai.

sentences.zh: 四月，以額魯特叛賊車布登多爾濟屬人分給察達克等。

translations.literal: In the fourth month distributed Oirat rebel Charindorji's subjects to Chadak and others.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month the followers of the Oirat rebel Charindorji were assigned to Chadak and others.

sentences.zh: 論察達克等俘輝特賊人功，予其子侍衛賚圖布慎、赤倫、洪郭爾等緞茶各有差。

translations.literal: Discussed Chadak and others' merit in capturing Khuwit prisoners, granted their sons attendant guards, Satubzhen, Chilen, Honggor and others satin and tea each in differing amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Chadak and others were commended for capturing Khuwit prisoners. Their sons, attendants Satubzhen, Chilen, Honggor, and others received rewards of satin and tea in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 九月，命車布登紮布等防範阿逆等擾烏梁海。

translations.literal: In the ninth month ordered Chobdenzhab and others to guard against the rebel and others disturbing Uriankhai.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Chobdenzhab and others were ordered to guard the Uriankhai against rebel raids.

sentences.zh: 十月，以阿勒泰淖爾烏梁海內附，諭授官加賞，定察達克所屬烏梁海每戶歲納二貂，給俸如內地官吏之半。

translations.literal: In the tenth month because Altai Nuur Uriankhai submitted internally, edict granted offices and added rewards, fixed Chadak's subject Uriankhai to pay two sables per household yearly, granting stipends at half inland officials.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Altai Nuur Uriankhai formally submitted. Offices and rewards were granted; Chadak's Uriankhai were assessed two sables per household annually and given stipends at half the rate of inland officials.

sentences.zh: 十一月，命烏梁海、紮哈沁人等歸還馬駝。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month ordered Uriankhai, Zhakhin people and others to return horses and camels.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Uriankhai, Zhakhin, and others were ordered to return requisitioned horses and camels.

sentences.zh: 烏梁海博和勒復降，仍授總管。

translations.literal: Uriankhai Bohele submitted again, still granted superintendent.
translations.idiomatic: The Uriankhai leader Bohele submitted again and was reappointed superintendent.

sentences.zh: 二十三年二月，歸併烏梁海管轄人戶編入之，允新舊烏梁海均於烏蘭固木種地，於吹河、勒和碩等處遊牧。

translations.literal: In the second month of the twenty-third year merged Uriankhai governed households into organization, permitted new and old Uriankhai all to farm at Uran Ulaan, pasture at Chui River, Leheshuo and other places.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the twenty-third year Uriankhai households under administration were reorganized. New and old Uriankhai alike were allowed to farm at Uran Ulaan and graze along the Chui, Leheshuo, and other rivers.

sentences.zh: 尋命移科布多烏梁海徙就阿爾泰山陽。

translations.literal: Soon ordered moving Kobdo Uriankhai to settle on the southern face of the Altai Mountains.
translations.idiomatic: They were soon ordered to move from Kobdo to the southern slopes of the Altai.

sentences.zh: 二十四年三月，仍命郡王車布登紮布總理烏梁海事。

translations.literal: In the third month of the twenty-fourth year again ordered prince Chobdenzhab to oversee Uriankhai affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the twenty-fourth year Prince Chobdenzhab was again placed in charge of Uriankhai affairs.

sentences.zh: 八月，烏梁海副都統莫尼紮布等招降鄂爾楚克人戶，附入烏梁海大臣管轄，授官有差。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Uriankhai vice commander-in-chief Monizhab and others won over Erchuk households, attached under Uriankhai minister jurisdiction, granted offices in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Vice Commander Monizhab and others brought in Erchuk households under ministerial jurisdiction and appointed officials as appropriate.

sentences.zh: 是年，定阿爾泰山之南額爾齊斯為是部牧地。

translations.literal: That year fixed south of Altai Mountains the Irtysh as this department's pasture lands.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Irtysh south of the Altai was fixed as the department's pastureland.

sentences.zh: 十二月，以哈薩克人掠烏梁海，諭察達克等防剿。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month because Kazakhs plundered Uriankhai, ordered Chadak and others to defend and suppress.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Chadak and others were ordered to repel Kazakhs who were raiding the Uriankhai.

sentences.zh: 二十五年四月，以收撫烏梁海原任總管阿喇逃散屬人交察達克等兼管。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the twenty-fifth year because of winning over Uriankhai former superintendent Ala's scattered subjects, handed to Chadak and others for joint management.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the twenty-fifth year the scattered followers of former superintendent Ala were placed under Chadak's joint management.

sentences.zh: 烏梁海總管紮布罕疏脫賊犯，上以年幼宥之，命察達克派員協同辦事。

translations.literal: Uriankhai superintendent Zabukan negligently let bandits escape; the emperor because of youth pardoned him, ordered Chadak to dispatch officers to assist in affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Superintendent Zabukan let bandits escape through negligence. The emperor pardoned him for his youth and ordered Chadak to assign officers to assist him.

sentences.zh: 二十六年七月，禁烏梁海私向哈薩克貿易。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the twenty-sixth year prohibited Uriankhai from private trade with Kazakhs.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the twenty-sixth year private trade between Uriankhai and Kazakhs was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 二十七年三月，允展烏梁海卡坐。

translations.literal: In the third month of the twenty-seventh year permitted expanding Uriankhai border station posts.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the twenty-seventh year additional Uriankhai border stations were authorized.

sentences.zh: 九月，嚴禁阿勒泰烏梁海竊取哈薩克馬匹。

translations.literal: In the ninth month strictly forbade Altai Uriankhai from secretly taking Kazakh horses.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Altai Uriankhai were strictly forbidden to steal Kazakh horses.

sentences.zh: 十月，以前經內附續逃入俄羅斯之烏梁海庫克新假我烏梁海名劫掠哈薩克，命察達克等領兵捕治之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month because previously submitted Uriankhai Kukxin who had fled into Russia falsely used our Uriankhai name to plunder Kazakhs, ordered Chadak and others to lead troops to capture and punish.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Kukxin, a Uriankhai who had submitted and then fled to Russia, was raiding Kazakhs in China's name. Chadak and others were ordered to capture him.

sentences.zh: 十二月，鑄烏梁海左、右翼總管印，分給察達克、圖克慎，銷原領阿勒泰烏梁海總管印。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month cast left and right wing Uriankhai superintendent seals, distributed to Chadak and Tubzhen, cancelled formerly received Altai Uriankhai superintendent seal.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month seals were cast for the left- and right-wing Uriankhai superintendents and given to Chadak and Tubzhen; the old Altai Uriankhai seal was revoked.

sentences.zh: 二十八年正月，庫克新就擒，戮之，以招撫人戶給察達克等分轄。

translations.literal: In the first month of the twenty-eighth year Kukxin was captured and executed; submitted households given to Chadak and others for divided jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the twenty-eighth year Kukxin was captured and executed, and his submitted followers were divided among Chadak and others.

sentences.zh: 三十八年十二月，以新土爾扈特郡王舍楞與是部散秩大臣烏爾圖那遜為婚，諭烏梁海緊接俄羅斯，瑚圖靈阿等嗣後詳為留意。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the thirty-eighth year because new Torghut prince Sheleng married this department's expectant official Urtunason, edict told Uriankhai adjoining Russia that Hutulinga and others thereafter should pay close attention in detail.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the thirty-eighth year the new Torghut prince Sheleng married Expectant Official Urtunason of this region. The Uriankhai along the Russian border were warned that Hutulinga and others must watch the frontier closely hereafter.

sentences.zh: 四十九年六月，給阿勒泰台站內大臣察達克轄烏梁海官兵協濟銀兩。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the forty-ninth year granted Altai station inner minister Chadak's subject Uriankhai military-civilian cooperative relief silver.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the forty-ninth year silver was granted to assist the troops and civilians under Inner Minister Chadak along the Altai courier route.

sentences.zh: 道光十八年，以哈薩克潛闌入阿勒泰烏梁海，命烏裏雅蘇台參贊大臣車林多爾濟領蒙兵逐之。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year of Daoguang because Kazakhs secretly crossed into Altai Uriankhai, ordered Uliassutai assistant minister Charindorji to lead Mongol troops to drive them out.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 18 Kazakhs slipped into Altai Uriankhai. Uliassutai Assistant Minister Charindorji was ordered to drive them out with Mongol troops.

sentences.zh: 科布多參贊大臣毓書遣科布多主事職銜哈楚暹領兵逐入烏梁海之哈薩克依滿等於烏裏雅蘇台。

translations.literal: Kobdo assistant minister Yushu dispatched Kobdo acting chief secretary Khachuxian leading troops to pursue Kazakhs Yiman and others who had entered Uriankhai to Uliassutai.
translations.idiomatic: Kobdo Assistant Minister Yushu sent Acting Chief Secretary Khachuxian to pursue the Kazakh Yiman and others from Uriankhai toward Uliassutai.

sentences.zh: 八月，追敗之于沙拉布拉克。

translations.literal: In the eighth month pursued and defeated them at Shalabrak.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month they were overtaken and defeated at Shalabrak.

sentences.zh: 九月，又逐再入烏梁海之哈薩克，使過於庫克伸阿林，予獎。

translations.literal: In the ninth month again drove Kazakhs who re-entered Uriankhai, making them pass beyond Kukshin Alin, granted reward.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Kazakhs who entered Uriankhai again were driven beyond Kukshin Alin and rewarded.

sentences.zh: 十一月，車林多爾濟奏前入烏梁海土爾扈特之哈薩克驅逐已淨，獲十餘人釋之。

translations.literal: In the November Charindorji memorialized that Kazakhs who had earlier entered Torghut Uriankhai had been fully driven out, captured over ten persons and released them.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Charindorji reported that Kazakhs who had entered Torghut pastures in Uriankhai had been cleared out; more than ten captives were taken and then released.

sentences.zh: 十二月，予烏梁海副都統車伯克達什等花翎，以論驅逐潛入遊牧哈薩克勞。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month granted Uriankhai vice commander-in-chief Cheberkdash and others peacock feathers, for merit in discussing driving out Kazakhs who had secretly entered pastures.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Vice Commander Cheberkdash and others received peacock feathers for driving Kazakhs out of the pastures.

sentences.zh: 十九年四月，哈薩克復入烏梁海，命車林多爾濟復調兵逐之。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the nineteenth year Kazakhs again entered Uriankhai, ordered Charindorji again to mobilize troops to drive them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the nineteenth year Kazakhs entered Uriankhai again, and Charindorji was again ordered to expel them.

sentences.zh: 八月，以阿勒泰烏梁海右翼散秩大臣達什濟克巴調營未到，嚴議。

translations.literal: In the eighth month because Altai Uriankhai right wing expectant official Dashjikba had not arrived when troops were called, severely censured.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Right-Wing Expectant Official Dashjikba was severely censured for failing to join the mobilization.

sentences.zh: 予驅逐哈薩克妥速之阿勒泰左翼散秩大臣達爾瑪阿紮拉頭品頂戴，仍下部優敘。

translations.literal: Granted Altai left wing expectant official Darmaazala first-rank cap button for properly and swiftly driving out Kazakhs, still ordered superior commendation below.
translations.idiomatic: Left-Wing Expectant Official Darmaazala, who had expelled the Kazakhs promptly, received a first-rank cap button and was recommended for further reward.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，科布多參贊大臣固慶奏：「達爾瑪阿紮拉時常稱疾偷安，不善撫馭。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year Kobdo assistant minister Guqing memorialized: "Darmaazala constantly claims illness for ease, does not govern well."
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year Kobdo Assistant Minister Guqing reported that Darmaazala often pleaded illness to avoid duty and governed poorly.

sentences.zh: 所任散秩大臣管烏梁海四旗事務煩，遊牧遼闊，且與俄羅斯接壤，責任綦重，請令離任，以參領唐嘎祿署之。

translations.literal: The expectant official he holds manages four Uriankhai banner affairs which are troublesome, pastures vast and remote, and moreover borders Russia, responsibility extremely heavy; request order him to leave office, with staff colonel Tanggalu acting.
translations.idiomatic: As expectant official he oversaw four Uriankhai banners across vast pastures bordering Russia—a weighty charge. Guqing asked that he be removed and Staff Colonel Tanggalu act in his place.

sentences.zh: 咸豐十年，與俄羅斯定西疆界約。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Xianfeng fixed western frontier boundary treaty with Russia.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 10 a western frontier boundary treaty was concluded with Russia.

sentences.zh: 同治三年八月，科布多參贊大臣廣鳳等奏：「卡倫以內阿勒泰烏梁海境內奇林河等地方十七處，有哈薩克公阿吉屬下之哈濟克居住。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the third year of Tongzhi Kobdo assistant minister Guangfeng and others memorialized: "Within the border pass inside Altai Uriankhai territory at Qilin River and seventeen other places, there are Hajik under Kazakh prince Aji's jurisdiction dwelling."
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of Tongzhi 3 Kobdo Assistant Minister Guangfeng reported that within the Altai Uriankhai border at Qilin River and sixteen other sites Hajik under Kazakh Prince Aji were living.

sentences.zh: 當分界未終之際，未便一旦驅逐。

translations.literal: While boundary demarcation is not finished, it is not convenient to drive them out at once.
translations.idiomatic: While the boundary was still unsettled, immediate expulsion was impractical.

sentences.zh: 倘分界後，萬不得已必須內遷，宜由塔爾巴哈台參贊大臣酌擇地方安置。

translations.literal: If after boundary demarcation there is absolutely no alternative but they must move inward, it is appropriate for Tarbagatai assistant minister to choose a place for resettlement.
translations.idiomatic: If relocation became unavoidable after demarcation, the Tarbagatai assistant minister should choose a site for them.

sentences.zh: 」十一月，俄人闌入是部庫什業莫多及塔布圖地方滋擾。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Russians crossed into this department's Kushiyamodo and Tabutu places causing disturbance.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Russians crossed into Kushiyamodo and Tabutu in this region and caused trouble.

sentences.zh: 明誼照會俄悉畢爾總督，先為查辦來我邊卡滋事官兵，俟明年兩國立界大臣會同建立牌博後，再派兵駐守。

translations.literal: Mingyi protested to Russian Siberian governor, first investigate troops who came to our border pass causing incidents, wait until next year when both countries' boundary commissioners jointly establish markers, then dispatch troops to garrison.
translations.idiomatic: Mingyi notified the Russian governor-general at Siberia to punish troops who had violated the border, and to garrison the line only after commissioners met the following year to set markers.

sentences.zh: 四年，以伊、塔諸城回變，命設烏梁海台站，遞送科城至塔城文報軍餉。

translations.literal: In the fourth year because Yili and Tarbagatai cities had Muslim rebellions, ordered establishing Uriankhai courier stations to relay documents and army provisions from Kobdo to Tarbagatai.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, with Muslim rebellions at Yili and Tarbagatai, Uriankhai courier stations were established to carry dispatches and supplies between Kobdo and Tarbagatai.

sentences.zh: 十二月，塔爾巴哈台參贊大臣錫霖劾廣鳳裁撤烏梁海台站，致文報軍餉阻滯。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Tarbagatai assistant minister Xilin impeached Guangfeng for abolishing Uriankhai stations, causing documents and army provisions to be obstructed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Tarbagatai Assistant Minister Xilin impeached Guangfeng for abolishing the Uriankhai stations and blocking dispatches and supplies.

sentences.zh: 諭廣鳳等議處，仍令復設。

translations.literal: Ordered Guangfeng and others punished by discussion, still ordered restoration.
translations.idiomatic: Guangfeng was ordered disciplined, but the stations were restored.

sentences.zh: 五年五月，塔爾巴哈台失守，領隊大臣圖庫爾領額魯特兵移至是部。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the fifth year Tarbagatai fell; detachment commander Tukur led Oirat troops moved to this department.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the fifth year Tarbagatai fell, and Detachment Commander Tukur moved his Oirat troops into the region.

sentences.zh: 七年三月，命奎昌會同俄官建立科布多毗連俄境界牌鄂博。

translations.literal: In the third month of the seventh year ordered Kuichang jointly with Russian officials to establish Kobdo border markers and cairns adjoining Russia.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the seventh year Kuichang was ordered to erect Kobdo's border markers and cairns with Russian officials.

sentences.zh: 九月，奎昌等以俄使未到，奏俟明年會辦立界。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Kuichang and others because Russian envoy had not arrived, memorialized to wait until next year for joint boundary establishment.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Kuichang reported that the Russian envoy had not come and asked to wait until the following year.

sentences.zh: 八年，奎昌與俄立界使臣巴布闊福勘明自科布多東北邊界賽留格木山適中之布果素克達巴哈起，向西南順賽留格木山至奎屯鄂拉，往西沿大阿爾泰山至海留圖兩河之山；

translations.literal: In the eighth year Kuichang and Russian boundary commissioner Babukov surveyed from Kobdo northeastern border Sairiugem Mountain central Bogusuk Dabaha, southwest along Sairiugem Mountain to Kuitun Ola, west along Great Altai Mountain to the mountain between two Hailiu rivers;
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year Kuichang and the Russian commissioner Babukov traced the line from the central Bogusuk Dabaha on the Sairiugem range at Kobdo's northeast corner southwest along the Sairiugem range to Kuitun Ola, then west along the Great Altai to the watershed between the two Hailiu rivers;

sentences.zh: 轉往南，順是山直至察奇勒莫斯鄂拉；

translations.literal: Turning south, following this mountain straight to Chaqilmos Ola;
translations.idiomatic: then south along that range to Chaqilmos Ola;

sentences.zh: 轉往東南，沿齋桑淖爾之邊，循喀喇額爾齊斯河岸，至瑪尼圖噶圖勒幹卡倫，分為兩國交界。

translations.literal: Turning southeast, along the border of Zaisan Nor, following Khara Irtysh riverbank to Manitu Gatuulgan border pass, divided as two countries' boundary.
translations.idiomatic: then southeast along the shore of Zaisan Nor and the Khara Irtysh to the Manitu Gatuulgan pass, where the two states' border ended.

sentences.zh: 建牌博凡二十：首曰布果素克達巴哈，次曰杜爾伯特達巴哈，曰塔布圖達巴哈，曰博勒齊爾，曰察幹布林哈蘇，曰烏蘭達巴哈，曰巴哈那斯達巴哈，曰薩爾那開，曰巴爾哈斯達巴哈，曰拜巴爾塔達巴哈，曰庫爾楚木，曰特勒克梯，曰固洛木拜，曰薩拉陶，曰薩勒欽車庫，曰特勒斯愛哩克，曰鄂裏雅布拉克，曰奇音克裏什，曰察奇勒莫斯，末曰瑪呢圖噶圖勒幹。

translations.literal: Established markers totaling twenty: first Bogusuk Dabaha, second Dorbed Dabaha, Tabutu Dabaha, Boleqir, Chagan Bulinhasu, Ulan Dabaha, Bahanas Dabaha, Sarnakai, Barhas Dabaha, Baibarta Dabaha, Kurchumu, Teleketi, Guoluomubai, Salatao, Saleqin Cheku, Teles Eirik, Oryaburak, Qinyinkirish, Chaqilmos, last Manitu Gatuulgan.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty markers were set: Bogusuk Dabaha, Dorbed Dabaha, Tabutu Dabaha, Boleqir, Chagan Bulinhasu, Ulan Dabaha, Bahanas Dabaha, Sarnakai, Barhas Dabaha, Baibarta Dabaha, Kurchumu, Teleketi, Guoluomubai, Salatao, Saleqin Cheku, Teles Eirik, Oryaburak, Qinyinkirish, Chaqilmos, and finally Manitu Gatuulgan.

sentences.zh: 自五月二十五日至七月三日竣事。

translations.literal: From the twenty-fifth of the fifth month to the third of the seventh month the work was completed.
translations.idiomatic: The work was finished between the twenty-fifth day of the fifth month and the third day of the seventh month.

sentences.zh: 十月，命棍噶紮拉參赴阿爾泰山收集徒眾，妥辦安插事宜，並免是部本年例貢貂皮。

translations.literal: In the tenth month ordered Gunggazala to go to Altai to gather disciples, properly handle resettlement matters, and exempt this department's annual tribute sable pelts for the year.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Gunggazala was sent to the Altai to gather followers, arrange resettlement, and exempt the region's annual sable tribute for that year.

sentences.zh: 其後伊犁索倫營兵移至阿爾泰山，與塔城額魯特兵皆由棍噶紮拉參暫統之。

translations.literal: Afterward Yili Solon camp soldiers moved to Altai Mountains, together with Tarbagatai Oirat troops all temporarily under Gunggazala's command.
translations.idiomatic: Later Solon troops from Yili and Oirat troops from Tarbagatai were moved to the Altai and placed temporarily under Gunggazala.

sentences.zh: 十年，署伊犁將軍榮全奏，以由科布多屬紮哈沁五台以西至霍博克薩里一、二千里，非就地設台，後路必斷。

translations.literal: In the tenth year acting Yili general Rongquan memorialized that from Kobdo-subject Zhakhin five stations west to Hoboksar one or two thousand li, if stations are not set on the spot, the rear route must be cut.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year Acting Yili General Rongquan argued that without courier stations along the twelve hundred li from Zhakhin's five posts west to Hoboksar, the rear route from Kobdo would be cut.

sentences.zh: 令烏梁海章蓋等於西翼設察罕通格、托克鄂博、德格圖阿滿三台，於東翼設多魯圖阿滿、額爾奇賽罕、烏裏雅斯三台。

translations.literal: Ordered Uriankhai janggi and others to set on west wing Chahan Tunge, Toke Oboo, Degtu Aman three stations, on east wing Dorutu Aman, Erchisaihan, Uriyas three stations.
translations.idiomatic: Uriankhai janggi were told to open three stations on the west wing—Chahan Tunge, Toke Oboo, Degtu Aman—and three on the east wing: Dorutu Aman, Erchisaihan, and Uriyas.

sentences.zh: 自是為科、塔兩城孔道。

translations.literal: From this became the thoroughfare between Kobdo and Tarbagatai cities.
translations.idiomatic: This became the main courier route between Kobdo and Tarbagatai.

sentences.zh: 十一年，調棍噶紮拉參所部索倫、額魯特兵赴塔城。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year transferred Gunggazala's Solon and Oirat troops to Tarbagatai.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year Gunggazala's Solon and Oirat troops were transferred to Tarbagatai.

sentences.zh: 十二年十一月，回匪竄新土爾扈特之布林根河，擾是部境，台站官兵紛紛逃散。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the twelfth year Muslim bandits slipped into new Torghut's Bulgan River, disturbing this department's territory; station troops and officers scattered in flight.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the twelfth year Muslim rebels entered the Bulgan River country of the new Torghut and raided the region; courier troops fled.

sentences.zh: 烏魯木齊領隊大臣錫綸率所部民勇自阿爾泰山南移營烏龍古河南岸，追至霍博克河下游，擊破之。

translations.literal: Urumqi detachment commander Xilun led his civilian militia from south of Altai Mountains moving camp to south bank of Ulonggu River, pursued to lower reaches of Hobok River and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Urumqi Detachment Commander Xilun led militia south of the Altai, crossed to the Ulonggu River, pursued the rebels to the lower Hobok River, and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 匪竄綏來縣北境，科布多參贊大臣保英等飭烏梁海速將軍台移回原處安設。

translations.literal: Bandits slipped into Suilai County northern territory; Kobdo assistant minister Baoying and others ordered Uriankhai quickly to move military courier stations back to original places and establish them.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels then slipped north into Suilai County. Kobdo Assistant Minister Baoying ordered the Uriankhai to restore the military courier stations at once.

sentences.zh: 光緒七年七月，以棍噶紮拉參在烏梁海達彥地方收撫哈薩克，擅殺頭目柯伯史之子，諭錫綸飭棍噶紮拉參即回籍。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the seventh year of Guangxu because Gunggazala at Uriankhai Dayan place in winning over Kazakhs arbitrarily killed headman Kebboshi's son, ordered Xilun to instruct Gunggazala immediately return to native place.
