translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of Guangxu 7 Gunggazala, while winning over Kazakhs at Dayan in Uriankhai, killed the son of headman Kebboshi without authority. Xilun was told to send him home at once.

sentences.zh: 八年，俄人議重劃科、塔中俄之界，欲占哈巴河一帶。

translations.literal: In the eighth year Russians discussed redemarcating the Kobdo-Tarbagatai Sino-Russian border, wishing to occupy the Kaba River region.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year Russia proposed remarking the Kobdo-Tarbagatai border and sought to take the Kaba River region.

sentences.zh: 科布多參贊大臣清泰等奏：「俄人數百名突至哈巴河。

translations.literal: Kobdo assistant minister Qingtai and others memorialized: "Several hundred Russians suddenly arrived at Kaba River."
translations.idiomatic: Kobdo Assistant Minister Qingtai reported that several hundred Russians had suddenly appeared on the Kaba River.

sentences.zh: 查新條約內，奎峒山即阿爾泰山。

translations.literal: Checking within the new treaty, Kuitun Mountain is the Altai Mountains.
translations.idiomatic: The new treaty identified Kuitun Mountain as the Altai range.

sentences.zh: 任其勘改，實有關礙。

translations.literal: If they are permitted to survey and alter it, there will actually be obstruction and harm.
translations.idiomatic: Allowing them to resurvey and alter the line would do real harm.

sentences.zh: 」八月，阿勒泰左翼散秩大臣等復呈清泰等以「前次界劃烏梁海西北境侵佔已多，此次若再占哈巴河，蒙民無地自容，誓死不能退讓」。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Altai left wing expectant officials and others again presented to Qingtai and others that "the previous boundary delimitation already encroached much on Uriankhai northwest territory; if Kaba River is occupied again, Mongol people will have no land to contain themselves, swearing death cannot yield."
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Altai left-wing expectant officials told Qingtai that the earlier demarcation had already taken much Uriankhai land in the northwest, and that if the Kaba River were lost the Mongols would have nowhere to live—they would die before yielding.

sentences.zh: 諭清安、額爾慶額會商金順、升泰妥籌。

translations.literal: Ordered Qing'an and Erqing'e to consult with Jinshun and Sheng Tai for proper planning.
translations.idiomatic: The throne instructed Qing'an and Erqing'e to consult Jinshun and Sheng Tai on how to proceed.

sentences.zh: 九年，額爾慶額偕參贊大臣升泰先期馳赴塞上，察邊塞沖要，辨山川主名。

translations.literal: In the ninth year Erqing'e together with assistant minister Sheng Tai went ahead to the frontier, inspected strategic border passes, and distinguished principal mountain and river names.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year Erqing'e and Assistant Minister Sheng Tai went ahead to the frontier, surveyed the strategic passes, and identified the principal mountains and rivers.

sentences.zh: 以棄哈巴河、奎峒山二要地烏梁海、哈薩克之眾均無所依，與俄官抗爭，相持兼旬，改以哈巴河以西阿拉喀別河為界，得展地百三十餘里，分道安設新界牌博。

translations.literal: Because abandoning the two key places Kaba River and Kuitun Mountain would leave Uriankhai and Kazakh masses with nothing to rely on, they contested with Russian officials for more than ten days, changed to take west of Kaba River the Alakabek River as boundary, obtained extending territory over 130 li, separately established new boundary markers.
translations.idiomatic: Abandoning the Kaba River and Kuitun Mountain would have left Uriankhai and Kazakhs homeless. After more than ten days of dispute with the Russians, the line was shifted to the Alakabek River west of the Kaba River, recovering more than 130 li of land, and new boundary markers were set.

sentences.zh: 既竣事，額爾慶額又繞北山道大彥淖爾安插烏梁海兩翼部落，以和裏木圖河、雅瑪圖、喲洛圖、西裏布拉克為夏季遊牧，以罕達蓋圖河、塔里雅圖、青格裏河、烏龍古河為冬季遊牧，而哈巴河仍由塔城置戍。

translations.literal: After completion, Erqing'e again by northern mountain route at Dayan Nor resettled both wings' Uriankhai tribes, taking Helimutu, Yamatu, Yaoluotu, Xilibulak as summer pastures, Handagaitu, Taliyatu, Qinggeli, Ulonggu rivers as winter pastures, while Kaba River was still garrisoned by Tarbagatai.
translations.idiomatic: When the work was done, Erqing'e resettled both Uriankhai wings at Dayan Nor by the northern route. Summer pastures were set along the Helimutu, Yamatu, Yaoluotu, and Xilibulak rivers; winter pastures along the Handagaitu, Taliyatu, Qinggeli, and Ulonggu rivers. Tarbagatai continued to garrison the Kaba River.

sentences.zh: 以金順奏，諭阿爾泰山烏梁海屬一帶遊牧地方，請飭棍噶紮拉參交回安插蒙民。

translations.literal: Because Jinshun memorialized, ordered Altai Mountain Uriankhai subject region pasture lands, requesting instruct Gunggazala to hand back and resettle Mongol people.
translations.idiomatic: On Jinshun's memorial, Gunggazala was ordered to return the Altai pasturelands he held and resettle the Mongols there.

sentences.zh: 十二年七月，以沙克都爾紮布等奏，復催棍噶紮拉參將徒眾仍回塔城。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the twelfth year because Shakduerzhab and others memorialized, again urged Gunggazala to move his disciples back to Tarbagatai.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the twelfth year Shakduerzhab and others again pressed Gunggazala to move his followers back to Tarbagatai.

sentences.zh: 十三年，諭劉錦棠等於新疆擇安插棍噶紮拉參之地。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year ordered Liu Jintang and others in Xinjiang to choose a place to resettle Gunggazala.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year Liu Jintang and others in Xinjiang were told to find land for Gunggazala's people.

sentences.zh: 十五年二月，劉錦棠奏移棍噶紮拉參徒眾於庫爾喀喇烏蘇屬之八英溝，讓還科布多借地。

translations.literal: In the second month of the fifteenth year Liu Jintang memorialized moving Gunggazala's disciples to Bayingou under Kurkara Usu jurisdiction, returning borrowed Kobdo land.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the fifteenth year Liu Jintang moved Gunggazala's followers to Bayingou in Kurkara Usu and returned the land borrowed from Kobdo.

sentences.zh: 承化寺就近所招徒眾，聽留居其寺哈巴河一帶。

translations.literal: Disciples recruited nearby by Chenghua Temple were permitted to remain dwelling in its temple's Kaba River region.
translations.idiomatic: Followers recruited near Chenghua Temple were allowed to remain along the Kaba River near the temple.

sentences.zh: 塔城自借地以來，即已派兵駐守，未便委去，俾俄人得乘便南下，從之。

translations.literal: Tarbagatai since borrowing the land had already dispatched troops to garrison, not convenient to abandon, lest Russians take advantage to move south; assented.
translations.idiomatic: Tarbagatai had garrisoned the borrowed land and could not withdraw without opening the way for a Russian advance south. The court agreed.

sentences.zh: 十八年六月，沙克都爾紮布、額爾慶額、魁福會勘，奏哈巴河借地暫難歸還，以塔城兩次分界後，蒙、哈不敷分住，請將借地展緩三年交割。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the eighteenth year Shakduerzhab, Erqing'e, Kuifu jointly surveyed and memorialized that Kaba River borrowed land was temporarily hard to return, because after Tarbagatai's two boundary delimitations Mongols and Kazakhs lacked room to dwell, requesting extend borrowed land handover three years.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the eighteenth year Shakduerzhab, Erqing'e, and Kuifu reported that the Kaba River loan could not yet be returned: after two Tarbagatai demarcations the Mongols and Kazakhs had too little land, and they asked for a three-year extension.

sentences.zh: 烏梁海困苦，擬令塔城哈薩克酌給牲畜，並籌安插逃戶，派兵駐守，允之。

translations.literal: Uriankhai in distress, planned to order Tarbagatai Kazakhs to provide livestock as appropriate, and plan resettlement of refugee households, dispatch troops to garrison; approved.
translations.idiomatic: The Uriankhai were in distress. Tarbagatai Kazakhs would supply livestock, refugee households would be resettled, and troops would garrison the area. This was approved.

sentences.zh: 其後科城屢請收回哈巴河，塔城爭之，迄未決。

translations.literal: Afterward Kobdo repeatedly requested recovering Kaba River, Tarbagatai contested it, to the end undecided.
translations.idiomatic: Kobdo later pressed repeatedly for the return of the Kaba River, Tarbagatai resisted, and the matter was never settled.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，邊防戒嚴，參贊大臣瑞洵檄烏梁海每旗挑兵二百名，半馬牛步，駐防本旗。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year border defenses were on alert; assistant minister Ruixun ordered each Uriankhai banner to select two hundred troops, half mounted half on foot, garrisoning their own banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year, with border defenses on alert, Assistant Minister Ruixun ordered each Uriankhai banner to raise two hundred men, half mounted and half on foot, to garrison their own territory.

sentences.zh: 事定，撤之。

translations.literal: When affairs settled, withdrew them.
translations.idiomatic: They were withdrawn once the crisis passed.

sentences.zh: 以烏梁海各旗保護俄商貨物，安全遊牧，一再請獎。

translations.literal: Because each Uriankhai banner protected Russian merchant goods and safe pastures, repeatedly requested rewards.
translations.idiomatic: The Uriankhai banners were commended repeatedly for protecting Russian merchants' goods and keeping the pastures secure.

sentences.zh: 二十九年閏五月，予烏梁海左右翼散秩大臣額爾克、舒諾三音博勒克均頭品頂戴，左翼總管倭齊爾紮布、桑敦紮布、右翼總管棍布紮布、瓦齊爾紮布均二品頂戴，左翼副都統察罕博勒克亦予獎。

translations.literal: In the intercalary fifth month of the twenty-ninth year granted Altai left and right wing expectant officials Erke and Shunu Sanyinboleke first-rank cap buttons, left wing superintendents Woqirzhab, Sundunzhab, right wing superintendents Gunbuzhab, Wachirzhab all second-rank cap buttons, left wing vice commander-in-chief Chahanboleke also rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary fifth month of the twenty-ninth year Left- and Right-Wing Expectant Officials Erke and Shunu Sanyinboleke received first-rank cap buttons; Left-Wing Superintendents Woqirzhab and Sundunzhab and Right-Wing Superintendents Gunbuzhab and Wachirzhab received second-rank cap buttons; Left-Wing Vice Commander Chahanboleke was also rewarded.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，塔城以哈巴城地交還科城。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year Tarbagatai returned Kaba city territory to Kobdo.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year Tarbagatai returned the Kaba River territory to Kobdo.

sentences.zh: 三十年五月，改設科布多辦事大臣駐阿爾泰山，以錫恆為之，仍駐承化寺。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the thirtieth year changed to establish Kobdo commissioner stationed at Altai Mountains, with Xiheng as holder, still stationed at Chenghua Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the thirtieth year a Kobdo commissioner was posted to the Altai, with Xiheng in the post, still residing at Chenghua Temple.

sentences.zh: 三十二年七月，定阿勒泰練陸軍馬隊一標、砲隊一營，設哈巴河防營委員，及沙紮蓋台至承化寺馬撥十六處，每處設蒙古馬兵五名，馬十匹。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the thirty-second year fixed Altai drilled army cavalry one battalion, artillery one company, established Kaba River defense camp commissioner, and from Shazhagaitai to Chenghua Temple horse relay sixteen places, each place setting five Mongol cavalry, ten horses.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the thirty-second year the Altai garrison was set at one cavalry battalion and one artillery company, a Kaba River defense commissioner was appointed, and sixteen Mongol relay posts of five men and ten horses each were placed from Shazhagaitai to Chenghua Temple.

sentences.zh: 開辦承化寺、庫克、呼布克木、哈巴河四處屯牧，建城署房屋，撥常年經費十三萬兩，開辦經費三十一萬兩有奇。

translations.literal: Opened farming-pastoral colonies at Chenghua Temple, Kuke, Hubukemu, Kaba River four places, built city office houses, allocated annual funds 130,000 taels, opening funds over 310,000 taels.
translations.idiomatic: Colonies were opened at Chenghua Temple, Kuke, Hubukemu, and the Kaba River; government buildings were erected; annual funds of 130,000 taels and startup funds of more than 310,000 taels were allocated.

sentences.zh: 十二月，是部七旗劃隸阿勒泰。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month this department's seven banners were placed under Altai jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month the department's seven banners were placed under Altai administration.

sentences.zh: 三十四年四月，錫恆奏停辦布倫托海上渠，下渠距水較近，擬再試種一年，克木奇官屯暫撥民辦。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the thirty-fourth year Xiheng memorialized stopping the upper canal at Burultohai, lower canal closer to water, planning to try planting one more year, Kemuchi official colony temporarily transferred to civilian management.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the thirty-fourth year Xiheng reported stopping the upper Burultohai canal; because the lower canal was closer to water he would try planting one more year, while the Kemuchi official colony would be run by civilians for the time being.

sentences.zh: 宣統三年二月，署辦事大臣延年奏開距承化寺七十里之紅墩渠，安插農民。

translations.literal: In the second month of the third year of Xuantong acting commissioner Yannian memorialized opening Hongdun canal seventy li from Chenghua Temple, resettling farmers.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Xuantong 3 Acting Commissioner Yannian proposed opening the Hongdun canal seventy li from Chenghua Temple and settling farmers there.

sentences.zh: 下部知之。

translations.literal: Ordered the ministries to be informed.
translations.idiomatic: The relevant ministries were notified.

sentences.zh: 地兼耕牧，有礦，有鹽。

translations.literal: The land combines farming and pastoralism, has mines, has salt.
translations.idiomatic: The land supported both farming and herding and held mines and salt.

sentences.zh: 是部有佐領七，副都統暨左右翼散秩大臣均兼一旗總管。

translations.literal: This department has seven assistant commandants; vice commander-in-chief and left and right wing expectant officials each concurrently hold one banner superintendent.
translations.idiomatic: The department had seven assistant commandants. The vice commander and the left- and right-wing expectant officials each doubled as superintendent of one banner.

sentences.zh: 卡倫自再劃界後，南起右翼散秩大臣旗之阿拉克別克，而北曰阿克塔斯，又東北曰克雜那阿斯，曰薩斯，曰呼吉爾圖布拉克，曰烏松呼吉爾圖，轉東曰胡布蘇，訖羅蓋布，東北至左翼散秩大臣旗之霍洞淖爾止，凡八卡倫。

translations.literal: Border passes since redemarcation: south from right wing expectant official banner's Alakabek, north called Aktas, northeast called Kezinaas, Sas, Khujirtublak, Usong Khujirtu, turning east called Hubusu, ending Luogaibu, northeast to left wing expectant official banner's Hodong Nor stop, totaling eight border passes.
translations.idiomatic: After the new demarcation eight border passes ran from Alakabek in the right wing southward to Aktas in the north, then northeast through Kezinaas, Sas, Khujirtublak, Usong Khujirtu, east through Hubusu to Luogaibu, and northeast to Hodong Nor in the left wing.

sentences.zh: 山之著者：西吉克圖山、荄拉圖山、霍穆達山、哈喇溫爾常山。

translations.literal: Notable mountains: Xijitu Mountain, Gailatu Mountain, Homuda Mountain, Khara Wenchang Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: Notable mountains included Xijitu, Gailatu, Homuda, and Khara Wenchang.

sentences.zh: 水之著者：察罕西魯河、薩格賽河、薩克布多河、青格裏河、額爾齊斯河。

translations.literal: Notable waters: Chahan Xilu River, Sagesai River, Sakbudo River, Qinggeli River, Irtysh River.
translations.idiomatic: Notable rivers included the Chahan Xilu, Sagesai, Sakbudo, Qinggeli, and Irtysh.

sentences.zh: 阿勒泰淖爾烏梁海，在科布多之西北，東唐努烏梁海，南阿勒泰烏梁海，西與北均俄羅斯。

translations.literal: Altai Nuur Uriankhai lies northwest of Kobdo, east Tannu Uriankhai, south Altai Uriankhai, west and north all Russia.
translations.idiomatic: Altai Nuur Uriankhai lay northwest of Kobdo, with Tannu Uriankhai to the east, Altai Uriankhai to the south, and Russia to the west and north.

sentences.zh: 初屬準噶爾。

translations.literal: Initially subordinate to the Dzungars.
translations.idiomatic: They too had originally belonged to the Dzungars.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十二年九月，賽音諾顏扎薩克貝勒車木楚克劄布招撫阿爾泰山烏梁海。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the twenty-second year of Qianlong Sayn Noyan zasaghtu beile Chemchukzhab won over Altai Mountain Uriankhai.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of Qianlong 22 Sayn Noyan zasaghtu beile Chemchukzhab won over the Altai Uriankhai.

sentences.zh: 有特勒伯克扎爾納克者，阿勒泰淖爾之烏梁海宰桑，攜屬至。

translations.literal: There was one Teleberk Zarnak, Altai Nuur Uriankhai zaisang, who brought his followers and came.
translations.idiomatic: The Altai Nuur zaisang Teleberk Zarnak arrived with his people.

sentences.zh: 詔車木楚克紮布定貢賞例，宣示德意。

translations.literal: Edict ordered Chemchukzhab to fix tribute and reward regulations, proclaiming imperial grace.
translations.idiomatic: Chemchukzhab was ordered to set tribute and reward rules and proclaim the emperor's favor.

sentences.zh: 十二月，授阿勒泰淖爾烏梁海宰桑特勒伯克等為總管。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month granted Altai Nuur Uriankhai zaisang Teleberk and others as superintendents.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Teleberk and other Altai Nuur zaisang were appointed superintendents.

sentences.zh: 二十三年秋，烏梁海總管阿拉善、恩克等叛，車木楚克紮布剿阿拉善等，就擒。

translations.literal: In autumn of the twenty-third year Uriankhai superintendents Alashan, Enke and others rebelled; Chemchukzhab suppressed Alashan and others, captured them.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the twenty-third year superintendents Alashan and Enke rebelled. Chemchukzhab defeated them and took Alashan prisoner.

sentences.zh: 恩兄竄哈屯河，冬，擒之。

translations.literal: Enke's elder brother fled to Khoto River; in winter captured him.
translations.idiomatic: Enke's elder brother fled to the Khoto River and was captured that winter.

sentences.zh: 尋定是部為二旗，各設總管一，歲貢貉皮如例，隸科布多參贊大臣。

translations.literal: Soon fixed this department as two banners, each setting one superintendent, yearly tribute raccoon dog pelts as regulation, subordinate to Kobdo assistant minister.
translations.idiomatic: The region was soon organized into two banners, each with a superintendent, annual raccoon-dog pelt tribute, under the Kobdo assistant minister.

sentences.zh: 道光中，查邊之政漸弛，俄人始築城於是部之吹河，我查邊界鄂博者往往不至其地。

translations.literal: In Daoguang times border inspection policy gradually slackened; Russians first built a city in this department's Chui River; our border inspection cairn examiners often did not reach the place.
translations.idiomatic: During the Daoguang reign border inspections grew lax. Russians built a town on the Chui River in this region, while Chinese inspectors often failed to reach the boundary cairns.

sentences.zh: 咸豐十年，定西疆界約，俄國畫界清單遂將是部包去。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Xianfeng fixed western frontier boundary treaty; Russia's boundary list then encircled this department.
translations.idiomatic: The Xianfeng 10 western frontier treaty placed this department within Russia on the Russian boundary list.

sentences.zh: 同治六年七月，科布多參贊大臣廣鳳等奏俄雅什達喇城衙門給阿勒泰淖爾兩旗總管文，言阿勒泰淖爾、綽羅什拜、巴什庫斯、吹河均系俄羅斯遊牧。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the sixth year of Tongzhi Kobdo assistant minister Guangfeng and others memorialized that Russian Yashidara city yamen gave Altai Nuur two banners' superintendents documents saying Altai Nuur, Choluoshibai, Bashkus, Chui River are all Russian pastures.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of Tongzhi 6 Kobdo Assistant Minister Guangfeng reported that the Russian office at Yashidara had told the Altai Nuur superintendents that Altai Nuur, Choluoshibai, Bashkus, and the Chui River were Russian pasture.

sentences.zh: 如有人言系中國遊牧，拿送俄城。

translations.literal: If anyone says they are Chinese pastures, send them to the Russian city.
translations.idiomatic: Anyone who claimed they were Chinese pastures was to be sent to the Russian authorities.

sentences.zh: 又俄人來綽羅什拜地方伐木，已飭總管察罕等善言開導，靜候兩國分界大臣將疆界議定換約，立界後，再按照所分界限遵行，此時不可伐木蓋房，致滋事端。

translations.literal: Also Russians came to Choluoshibai place to cut timber; already ordered superintendents Chahan and others to instruct gently, quietly wait until both countries' boundary commissioners fix the border and exchange treaty, after establishing boundary then follow the divided line; at this time cannot cut timber or build houses, lest cause incidents.
translations.idiomatic: Russians were also cutting timber at Choluoshibai. Superintendents Chahan and others were told to reason with them and wait until the boundary treaty was signed; until then they must not cut timber or build houses.

sentences.zh: 時俄國官兵執去我查閱哈屯河扎薩克紮那紮布及台吉差官、蒙古員兵等，阻我查邊道路，稱是部遊牧為俄國地面，不許中國人往來。

translations.literal: At the time Russian troops seized our Khoto River inspector zasaghtu Zanazhab and taiji dispatch officers, Mongol soldiers and others, blocking our border inspection route, claiming this department's pastures are Russian territory, not permitting Chinese to come and go.
translations.idiomatic: Russian troops seized Inspector Zanazhab of Khoto River, taiji officers, and Mongol soldiers on the patrol route, claiming the pastures were Russian and barring Chinese passage.

sentences.zh: 十月，阿勒泰淖爾總管莽泰等報俄官取莽泰旗下一百四十餘人及總管察罕旗下二百四十餘人手印。

translations.literal: In the tenth month Altai Nuur superintendent Mangtai and others reported Russian officials took over 140 persons under Mangtai's banner and over 240 handprints under superintendent Chahan's banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Superintendent Mangtai reported that Russian officials had taken more than 140 men from his banner and collected fingerprints from more than 240 men under Superintendent Chahan.

sentences.zh: 九月，明誼、錫霖、博勒果索與俄分界大臣照議單勘分西界，是部地遂非清有。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Mingyi, Xilin, Boleiguosuo with Russian boundary commissioners according to discussion list surveyed western boundary; this department's territory was then no longer Qing possession.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Mingyi, Xilin, and Boleiguosuo demarcated the western border with Russian commissioners according to the negotiating list, and this department passed out of Qing control.

sentences.zh: 初議遷是部誠心內附者於卡內，而總管莽泰等言兩旗人丁祈全入卡內住牧。

translations.literal: Initially discussed relocating this department's sincerely submitting people inside the border pass, but superintendents Mangtai and others said both banners' population prayed to all enter inside the pass to pasture.
translations.idiomatic: At first the court planned to move those who had sincerely submitted inside the border, but Mangtai and other superintendents said both banners wished to enter the pass entirely.

sentences.zh: 廣鳳等諭以「所被俄國分去地面舊住人丁，隨地歸為俄國，務令安居故土，各守舊業，立界後斷不致仍前擾害」。

translations.literal: Guangfeng and others instructed them: "The ground taken by Russia where old inhabitants dwelt, follow the land to become Russian subjects; be sure to dwell peacefully in old lands, each keep old occupations; after establishing boundary will certainly not again disturb as before."
translations.idiomatic: Guangfeng told them that people on land now assigned to Russia must stay on their old grounds, keep their occupations, and would not be harassed once the boundary was fixed.

sentences.zh: 隨令莽岱等出卡回牧，並內徙之議亦輟。

translations.literal: Then ordered Mangdai and others to exit the pass and return to pastures, and the inward migration plan also ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Mangdai and others were then ordered out of the pass to their pastures, and the plan to move them inward was dropped.

sentences.zh: 是部有佐領四。

translations.literal: This department has four assistant commandants.
translations.idiomatic: This department had four assistant commandants.
